point: 询问与回答能力（can 句型）
pattern: Can you/... help? Yes, ... can. ... can ...
rule: 用 Can 开头问别人能不能做某事，回答用 Yes, ... can. 后面再接能做的动作。

examples.en: Can you help? Yes, I can. I can clean my room.
examples.zh: 你能帮忙吗？是的，我能。我能打扫我的房间。

examples.en: Can she help? Yes, she can. She can do some chores.
examples.zh: 她能帮忙吗？是的，她能。她能做些家务。

examples.en: Can he help? Yes, he can. He can sweep the floor.
examples.zh: 他能帮忙吗？是的，他能。他能扫地。

examples.en: Can we help? Yes, we can. That's for sure!
examples.zh: 我们能帮忙吗？是的，我们能。那是肯定的！

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

rule: 用 What's ... job? 问某人的工作，回答用 He's/She's a 加职业名词。

examples.en: What's your mother's job? She's a doctor.
examples.zh: 你妈妈的工作是什么？她是一名医生。

examples.en: What's your father's job? He's a factory worker.
examples.zh: 你爸爸的工作是什么？他是一名工厂工人。

examples.en: What's Mike's job? He's a doctor.
examples.zh: Mike 的工作是什么？他是一名医生。

examples.en: What's your mother's job? She's a teacher.
examples.zh: 你妈妈的工作是什么？她是一名老师。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

point: 一般现在时（描述家庭日常）
rule: 用一般现在时描述经常做的家务，主语是 I 或 We 时动词用原形。

examples.en: I sweep the floor. It's easy.

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

point: There be 句型（描述家庭情况）
rule: 用 There is 表示有单数事物，用 There are 表示有复数事物。

examples.en: You have a big family. Is this your father?
examples.zh: 你有一个大家庭。这是你爸爸吗？

examples.en: Yes, it is. He's a PE teacher.
examples.zh: 是的，他是。他是一名体育老师。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

pattern: doctor, nurse, farmer, factory worker, office worker
rule: 这些是表示职业的名词，注意 factory worker 和 office worker 是复合名词。

examples.en: Doctors are great! My father is a doctor too.
examples.zh: 医生们很棒！我爸爸也是一名医生。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

point: 疑问句：询问家庭活动（What do ... do?）
pattern: What do you do with your family? I often ...
rule: 用 What do you do with your family? 问和家人一起做什么，回答用 I often 加动词原形。

examples.en: What do you do with your family?
examples.zh: 你和你的家人一起做什么？

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

rule: 用 is 加形容词来描述朋友的特征，比如高、矮、强壮、瘦等。
subject: 英语
title: My friends

rule: 用 has 加形容词和 hair 来描述朋友的头发长短。

examples.zh: 有些朋友的头发是短的。
有些朋友的头发是长的。

subject: 英语
title: My friends

pattern: What's his/her name? His/Her name is ...
rule: 用 What's his/her name? 来问朋友的名字，回答用 His/Her name is ...
subject: 英语
title: My friends

point: 描述朋友经常做的事情
rule: 用 often 加动词原形来描述朋友经常做的事情。

examples.en: She often reads books with me.
He often helps me with English.

subject: 英语
title: My friends

point: 描述和朋友一起做的事情
rule: 用 We often 加动词原形来描述和朋友一起做的事情。

examples.zh: 我们经常在这里玩游戏。

subject: 英语
title: My friends

rule: 用 is 加形容词来描述朋友的性格，比如善良、安静、有趣等。
subject: 英语
title: My friends

rule: 用 There is 表示“有一个……”，用 There are 表示“有一些……”，后面接地点或事物。

examples.en: There are books, pencils and clothes.

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

rule: 用 There is also 表示“还有一个……”，用来补充说明社区里还有别的地方。

examples.en: There is also a nice park over there.
examples.zh: 那边还有一个漂亮的公园。

examples.en: There is also a nice shop.

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

point: 一般现在时（描述社区里的活动）
rule: 用一般现在时描述经常做的事情，often 表示“经常”，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: I often play there with my friends.
examples.zh: 我经常和朋友们在那里玩。

examples.en: I often take a walk there.

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

point: What do people do here? 询问地点用途
rule: 用 What do people do here? 询问“人们在这里做什么”，回答用动词短语说明活动。
subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

point: 情态动词 can 表示能力
rule: 用 can 表示“能够做某事”，后面接动词原形。

examples.zh: 孩子们可以在那里玩得开心。

examples.en: I can read stories about them.
examples.zh: 我可以读关于它们的故事。

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

point: 名词复数与 some/many 搭配
rule: some 和 many 后面接复数名词，表示“一些”或“许多”。

examples.en: Some ducks are in the park.
There are many old things and photos.

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

rule: 用 is/are 加上动词的 -ing 形式，表示现在正在做的事情。

examples.en: Chen Jie is making the bed.
Binbin and John are telling funny stories.
examples.zh: 彬彬和约翰正在讲有趣的故事。

examples.en: She is helping some students cross the road.
examples.zh: 她正在帮助一些学生过马路。

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

point: 一般现在时（描述职业与日常职责）
pattern: He/She is a ... . He/She + 动词原形 ...
rule: 用 is a/an 介绍职业，再用一般现在时说明他/她经常做什么。

examples.en: He's a cleaner. He cleans the community.
examples.zh: 他是一名清洁工。他打扫社区。

examples.en: Our neighbour is a firefighter. He often helps people.
examples.zh: 我们的邻居是一名消防员。他经常帮助人们。

examples.en: He's a school bus driver. He takes us to school every day.
examples.zh: 他是一名校车司机。他每天送我们去学校。

examples.en: She's a nurse. She helps people.
examples.zh: 她是一名护士。她帮助人们。

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

pattern: What jobs are important in a community? / You're a ... .
rule: 用 What jobs... 询问社区里哪些工作重要，用 You're a ... 说出对方的职业。

examples.en: What jobs are important in a community?
examples.zh: 社区里哪些工作是重要的？

examples.en: My neighbour is a police officer. She helps a lot of people.
examples.zh: 我的邻居是一名警察。她帮助很多人。

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

pattern: What are the people doing? / What are the students doing for their community?
rule: 用 What are ... doing? 询问人们正在做什么。

examples.en: What are the students doing for their community?
examples.zh: 学生们正在为社区做什么？

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

rule: 用 There is 表示有一个，用 There are 表示有一些。

examples.en: There are three elephants in the photo.
There is a big lake in the park.

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示能够做某事，后面加动词原形。

examples.en: I can sing for old people, or tell stories for kids!
examples.zh: 我可以为老人唱歌，也可以为孩子们讲故事！

examples.en: You can all help old people.

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

rule: 用 should 表示应该做某事，后面加动词原形。
subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

rule: 用这个句型问某个地方的天气怎么样。

examples.en: What's the weather like in Beijing?
What's the weather like in Sydney?
What's the weather like in Harbin?

subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用 It's 加天气形容词来描述天气，可以用 and 连接两个天气词。
subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用一般现在时描述现在的天气状况。
subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用 can 表示在某种天气下我们可以做的事情。

examples.en: We can go to the library.

subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用 can't 表示在某种天气下我们不能做的事情。

examples.en: We can't play basketball in the park.
examples.zh: 我们不能在公园里打篮球。
我们不能在外面踢足球。

subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用 There is 表示某处有某种天气现象。
subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

pattern: Whose ... is it? / Whose ... are these? It's ...'s. / They're ...'s.
rule: 用 Whose 问“这是谁的”，回答用名词所有格（人名后加 's）表示所属。

examples.en: Whose sweater is it? It's Lu Wei's.
examples.zh: 这是谁的毛衣？是陆伟的。

examples.en: Whose shirts are these? They're Xiao Fei's.
examples.zh: 这些衬衫是谁的？是小飞的。

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

rule: 在人名或物名后加 's 表示“……的”，用于说明东西属于谁。

examples.zh: 这条紫色连衣裙是妈妈的。
这件绿色毛衣是迈克的。

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 季节与衣物搭配（祈使句）
rule: 用 In 加季节，后面接 wear 加衣物，表示“在某个季节穿什么”。
subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 一般现在时（描述季节特征）
rule: 用 is 加形容词描述季节的颜色、温度等特征。
subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 加动词原形表示“我能做某事”，常用于说自己在季节里能做什么。

examples.en: I can go to the park and fly kites.
I can wear my pink sweater.

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

rule: 用 wh- 开头的词提问，如 who 问人、what 问事物、where 问地点、why 问原因、which 问哪一个、whose 问所属。

examples.en: What do you usually do on Christmas Day?
examples.zh: 你通常在圣诞节做什么？

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 情态动词 can 表能力/建议
rule: 用 can 表示“能、可以”做某事，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: We can go to the park and give out some posters.
examples.zh: 我们可以去公园发一些海报。

examples.en: We can also water the plants.
examples.zh: 我们还可以给植物浇水。

subject: 英语
title: Let's help!

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
rule: 描述经常做的事，主语是 he/she 时动词加 s。

examples.en: He often helps the children there.
examples.zh: 他经常在那里帮助孩子们。
她在那里做美味的食物。

examples.en: He plays football with the children.
examples.zh: 他和孩子们一起踢足球。

examples.en: My family often helps at the children's centre.
examples.zh: 我的家人经常在儿童中心帮忙。

subject: 英语
title: Let's help!

rule: 表示正在做的事，用 is/are 加动词的 ing 形式。

examples.en: Chen Jie is giving out some posters.
They take a lot of photos.

subject: 英语
title: Let's help!

rule: 用 There is/are 表示“有……”，单数用 is，复数用 are。

examples.en: There are fish, dolphins and big elephants too.
examples.zh: 那里还有鱼、海豚和大象。

subject: 英语
title: Let's help!

rule: 用 What、Which、How 开头提问，分别问“什么、哪一个、怎样”。

examples.en: What is the weather like today?
How can you help your community?

subject: 英语
title: Let's help!

rule: 用 is 加形容词描述人的性格或特征。
subject: 英语
title: Let's help!

point: This is the way ... 句型
pattern: This is the way + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...
rule: 用来说明某人做某事的方式，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: This is the way she cleans her room.
examples.zh: 这就是她打扫房间的方式。

examples.en: This is the way he cleans his room.
examples.zh: 这就是他打扫房间的方式。

examples.en: This is the way they clean their rooms.
examples.zh: 这就是他们打扫房间的方式。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

point: 情态动词 can 表能力或建议
pattern: 主语 + can + 动词原形 + ...
rule: can 后面接动词原形，表示能够做某事或建议做某事。

examples.en: We can go to the library.
We can do what we like.
examples.zh: 我们可以做我们喜欢的事。

examples.en: We can meet and help each other.
examples.zh: 我们可以见面并互相帮助。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用来表示某处存在某物，is 用于单数，are 用于复数。

examples.en: There are flowers and people to see.
There are many ways to help your town and community.
examples.zh: 有很多方法可以帮助你的城镇和社区。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

point: 情态动词 should 表建议
pattern: 主语 + should + 动词原形 + ...
rule: should 后面接动词原形，用来提出建议。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

point: 情态动词 have to 表必须
pattern: 主语 + have to + 动词原形 + ...
rule: have to 后面接动词原形，表示必须做某事。

examples.en: Do I have to wear all this?
Do I have to take all this?

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 以动词原形开头，用来提出建议或命令。

examples.zh: 让我们和每个人交朋友。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: What's your name? / My name's ... / I'm ...
rule: 用 What's your name? 问别人叫什么，回答可以说 My name's ... 或 I'm ...。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

point: 询问与回答国籍/来自哪里
pattern: Where are you from? / I'm from ... / Where is he/she from? / He's/She's from ...
rule: 用 Where are you from? 问对方来自哪里，回答用 I'm from ...；问第三人称用 Where is he/she from?，回答用 He's/She's from ...。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

rule: 用 That's ... 介绍远处或新出现的人；用 Who's that ...? 问那是谁。

examples.zh: 那是我们的新邻居艾米。

examples.en: That's my new neighbour, Mr Lin.
examples.zh: 那是我的新邻居林先生。

subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

pattern: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too. / Nice to see you. / Nice to see you too.
rule: 初次见面用 Nice to meet you.，对方回应 Nice to meet you too.；再次见面用 Nice to see you.，回应 Nice to see you too。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

point: 礼貌用语：请、谢谢、不客气、让我帮忙
pattern: After you. / Thank you. / You're welcome. / Let me help.
rule: After you. 表示请（你先）；Thank you. 表示感谢；You're welcome. 表示不客气；Let me help. 表示让我来帮忙。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

rule: 用 is 表示单数，用 are 表示复数，说明人或物是什么、在哪里。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

point: 描述动物/物品特征（It has...）
rule: 用 It has 来说一个动物或物品有什么身体部位或特征，后面接名词短语。

examples.en: It has a long tail and big ears.
examples.zh: 它有一条长尾巴和大耳朵。

examples.en: It has a long body and short legs.
examples.zh: 它有一个长身体和短腿。

examples.en: It has long ears and a short tail.

subject: 英语
title: Expressing yourself

point: 一般疑问句 Do you...? 及回答 Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
pattern: Do you ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you 开头问对方是否做某事，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.。

examples.en: Do you like dogs? Yes, I do.
examples.zh: 你喜欢狗吗？是的，我喜欢。

examples.en: Do you often say that to your mum? Yes, I do.
examples.zh: 你经常对你妈妈说那句话吗？是的，我经常说。

examples.en: Do you often do this, John? No, I don't.
examples.zh: 你经常这样做吗，约翰？不，我不经常做。

examples.en: Do you have a pet? Yes, I have a dog.
examples.zh: 你有宠物吗？是的，我有一只狗。

subject: 英语
title: Expressing yourself

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示某人或某物能够做某事，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: We can make animals with fruit.
examples.zh: 我们可以用水果做动物。

examples.en: We can be tall or short.
We can express our ideas in different ways!
examples.zh: 我们可以用不同的方式表达我们的想法！

subject: 英语
title: Expressing yourself

rule: 用 Let's 开头提出一起做某事的建议，后面接动词原形。
subject: 英语
title: Expressing yourself

point: 形容词描述外貌（long, short, fat, thin, slow, big）
rule: 用 is 后面接形容词来描述人或动物的样子。

examples.en: He's old and fat, and he's also very slow.
examples.zh: 他又老又胖，而且非常慢。

examples.en: We can be fat or thin.
We can be tall or short.

subject: 英语
title: Expressing yourself

rule: 用 like 表示喜欢某物，第三人称单数用 likes。
subject: 英语
title: Expressing yourself

point: 询问与回答物品名称（单数）
rule: 用 What's this? 问“这是什么”，用 It's a ... 回答，后面接一个单数物品。
subject: 英语
title: Learning better

point: 询问与回答物品名称（复数）
rule: 用 What are these? 问“这些是什么”，用 They're ... 回答，后面接复数名词。
subject: 英语
title: Learning better

rule: 用 Can I use your ..., please? 礼貌地借别人的东西，回答可以用 Sure. / No problem. 等。

examples.zh: 我能用一下你的钢笔吗？

examples.en: Excuse me. Can I use your eraser, please?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，我能用一下你的橡皮吗？

subject: 英语
title: Learning better

rule: 用 I ... with my ... 说明“我用……来……”，后面接感官动词和身体部位。
subject: 英语
title: Learning better

rule: 用动词开头说“用你的……做……”，如 Write with your pencil. 表示学习动作。

examples.en: Draw a line with your ruler.
Put the pen in your pencil box.
examples.zh: 把钢笔放进你的铅笔盒里。
把所有东西放进你的书包里。

subject: 英语
title: Learning better

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 I can ... 表示“我能……”，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: I can use paper, pencils, books and computers to learn.
examples.zh: 我能用纸、铅笔、书和电脑来学习。

examples.en: I can ask others politely to share school things.
examples.zh: 我能礼貌地请别人分享学习用品。

subject: 英语
title: Learning better

rule: 用 Would you like some ...? 来问别人要不要吃点东西，some 后面可以接可数名词复数或不可数名词。

examples.en: Would you like some rice and meat?
examples.zh: 你想要一些米饭和肉吗？

examples.en: Would you like some meat, Zoom?

subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

rule: 用 I'd like some ... 来表示自己想要一些东西，some 后面可以接可数名词复数或不可数名词。

examples.en: I'd like some bread and eggs, please.
examples.zh: 我想要一些面包和鸡蛋，谢谢。

examples.en: I'd like some juice and noodles.
examples.zh: 我想要一些果汁和面条。

examples.en: I'd like some milk and bread.
examples.zh: 我想要一些牛奶和面包。

examples.en: I'd like some bread, eggs and cake.
examples.zh: 我想要一些面包、鸡蛋和蛋糕。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

rule: 别人问你要不要某物时，想要就说 Yes, please. 然后说 Thanks. 或 Thank you. 表示感谢。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

rule: 别人问你要不要某物时，不想要就说 No, thank you. 或 No, thanks. 礼貌地拒绝。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

rule: 用 I like/love ... 来说自己喜欢什么，后面直接加食物名称。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

point: 一般现在时（描述食物属性）
rule: 用 is 或 are 来说食物是什么或怎么样，单数用 is，复数用 are。

examples.zh: 健康食物不是开玩笑的。

examples.en: Meat, milk and eggs are good too.
examples.zh: 肉、牛奶和鸡蛋也是好的。

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables are colourful and healthy.
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜是五颜六色且健康的。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

rule: 用 I have 来说自己有什么东西，some 后面跟复数名词。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What time is it? / It's ... o'clock.
rule: 用 What time is it? 问现在几点，回答用 It's + 时间。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: It's time to/for ... 表该做某事了
pattern: It's time to + 动词原形 + ... / It's time for + 名词 + ...
rule: It's time to 后面接动词原形，It's time for 后面接名词，表示“该……了”。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 一般现在时（have/has 表拥有）
rule: 用 have 或 has 表示“有”，第三人称单数用 has。

examples.en: I have a lot of animals.
You already have too many shorts.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: Hello! / Hi! / What's your name? / My name is ... / I'm ... / Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
rule: 见面时先打招呼，再问或说自己的名字，最后互相说很高兴认识你。

examples.en: Hello! My name is Mike Black.
Hi! My name is Wu Binbin.

subject: 英语
title: How do we make friends?

point: 一般现在时（第一人称陈述）
rule: 用 I 开头说“我”做什么，动词用原形，表示经常或现在做的事。
subject: 英语
title: How do we make friends?

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
rule: 说别人做什么时，动词后面要加 s 或 es。
subject: 英语
title: How do we make friends?

rule: 用 Am I 开头问“我是……吗？”，回答用 Yes, I am! 或 No, I'm not.

examples.en: Am I a good friend? Yes, I am!
examples.zh: 我是好朋友吗？是的，我是！

subject: 英语
title: How do we make friends?

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示“能、会”做某事，后面跟动词原形。

examples.en: I can greet people and show friendliness.
examples.zh: 我能问候别人并表现出友好。

subject: 英语
title: How do we make friends?

rule: 用动词原形开头告诉别人做什么，句末加感叹号。
subject: 英语
title: How do we make friends?

rule: 用 This is my ... 来介绍自己的家人或朋友。

examples.en: This is my friend, Sarah Miller.
examples.zh: 这是我的朋友，莎拉·米勒。

subject: 英语
title: What makes a family?

pattern: Is this/that your ...? Yes, it is. / No, it's my ...
rule: 用 Is this/that your ...? 来问这是不是你的家人，回答用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it's my ...。

examples.en: Yes, it is. This is my ...

subject: 英语
title: What makes a family?

rule: 用 I have a/an ... 来说自己有什么家人。

examples.zh: 我也有两个表兄弟姐妹。

examples.en: I have a brother, and a baby sister.
examples.zh: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。

subject: 英语
title: What makes a family?

pattern: I am ... / This is ... / We are ...
rule: 用 am/is/are 来说“是”，I 后面用 am，单数用 is，复数用 are。
subject: 英语
title: What makes a family?

point: 名词单复数与量词 a/an/two
rule: a 用在辅音开头的词前，an 用在元音开头的词前，two 表示两个。

examples.zh: 我也有两个表兄弟姐妹。

examples.en: I have a brother, and a baby sister.
examples.zh: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。

subject: 英语
title: What makes a family?

rule: 用 with 表示“和……一起”，后面接人。

examples.zh: 我和我的表兄弟姐妹们说话。

subject: 英语
title: What makes a family?

point: 询问与回答是否拥有宠物
pattern: Do you have a pet? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you have...? 来问别人有没有宠物，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.

examples.en: Yes, I do. I have a dog.

subject: 英语
title: How are animals different?

rule: 用 I have a ... 来说自己有什么，a 后面接单数名词。
subject: 英语
title: How are animals different?

rule: 用 I like ... 来说自己喜欢什么，后面可以直接加名词。
subject: 英语
title: How are animals different?

pattern: What's this? / What's that? It's a/an ...
rule: 用 What's this? 或 What's that? 来问这是什么，回答用 It's a/an ...。

examples.zh: 这是什么？它是一只狐狸。
这是什么？它是一头大象。
这是什么？它是一只猴子。
这是什么？它是一只熊猫。

subject: 英语
title: How are animals different?

point: 用形容词描述动物特征
rule: 用 The + 动物 + is + 形容词 来描述动物的特点。
subject: 英语
title: How are animals different?

rule: 用 There is/are ... 来说某处有某物，is 用于单数，are 用于复数。
subject: 英语
title: How are animals different?

point: 询问与回答喜好（Do you like...?）
pattern: Do you like ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't. I like ...
rule: 用 Do you like 开头问别人喜不喜欢某样东西，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.，再说出自己喜欢的东西。

examples.en: No, I don't. I like bananas.
examples.zh: 不，我不喜欢。我喜欢香蕉。

subject: 英语
title: How do we connect with plants?

rule: 用 I like 后面加水果或事物，表示自己喜欢什么。
subject: 英语
title: How do we connect with plants?

rule: 用 are 后面加形容词，描述水果或植物的样子，比如小、长。

examples.en: Apples and oranges make you strong.

subject: 英语
title: How do we connect with plants?

rule: 用 need 表示某样东西需要什么，比如植物需要空气、水和阳光。

examples.en: Plants need air, water and sun.
examples.zh: 植物需要空气、水和阳光。

examples.en: Apple trees need air, water and sun.
examples.zh: 苹果树需要空气、水和阳光。

examples.en: I need air, water and sun.

subject: 英语
title: How do we connect with plants?

rule: 用 can 表示能够做某事，比如我们可以浇水、种树。
subject: 英语
title: How do we connect with plants?

point: There be 句型（描述拥有）
rule: 用 I have 表示我拥有某样东西，比如我有一个花园。
subject: 英语
title: How do we connect with plants?

rule: 用来问某样东西是什么颜色。
subject: 英语
title: Why are colours important?

rule: 用 It's 加颜色词来回答是什么颜色。
subject: 英语
title: Why are colours important?

rule: 用 is 或 are 加颜色词来说某样东西是什么颜色。
subject: 英语
title: Why are colours important?

rule: 用来问别人喜欢什么颜色。
subject: 英语
title: Why are colours important?

rule: 用 I like 加颜色词来说自己喜欢什么颜色。

examples.en: I like yellow, red and blue.
examples.zh: 我喜欢黄色、红色和蓝色。

subject: 英语
title: Why are colours important?

rule: 用 and 连接两种颜色，再用 make 加新颜色来说颜色混合。

examples.zh: 红色和蓝色混合成紫色。
蓝色和黄色混合成绿色。

subject: 英语
title: Why are colours important?

pattern: How old are you? I'm ... years old.
rule: 用 How old are you? 问别人几岁，回答用 I'm 加数字加 years old。
subject: 英语
title: Why are numbers important?

rule: 用 How many 加名词复数问有多少，回答用数字。
subject: 英语
title: Why are numbers important?

point: 数字 1 到 10 的读法
pattern: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten
rule: 用这些单词表示 1 到 10 的数量。

examples.en: One head, two legs, ten toes.
examples.zh: 一个头，两条腿，十个脚趾。

examples.en: One head, eight eyes, eight legs.
examples.zh: 一个头，八只眼睛，八条腿。

examples.en: One head, four wings, six legs.
examples.zh: 一个头，四只翅膀，六条腿。

subject: 英语
title: Why are numbers important?

rule: 用 This is my 加家人或朋友的名字来介绍别人。

examples.en: Hi, Sam! This is my sister, Xinxin.
Binbin, this is my brother, Sam.

subject: 英语
title: Why are numbers important?

rule: 用 It's 加数字加 o'clock 表示整点时间。
subject: 英语
title: Why are numbers important?

rule: 用 There is 或 There are 表示某处有某物。
subject: 英语
title: Why are numbers important?

pattern: 主语 + did/didn't + 动词原形；主语 + 动词过去式
rule: 描述过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式，比如 went, visited, ate, climbed。

examples.en: I visited the "Gingerbread House" last Saturday.
examples.zh: 上周六我参观了“姜饼屋”。

examples.en: Amy walked around the Palace Museum.
examples.zh: 艾米在故宫里逛了一圈。

examples.en: We ate some famous Xi'an noodles.
examples.zh: 我们吃了一些著名的西安面条。

subject: 英语
title: Amazing places

pattern: Where did you go (over the ...)? I went to ...
rule: 用 Where did you go? 问别人过去去了哪里，回答用 I went to + 地点。

examples.en: Where did you go over the summer holidays, Binbin?
I went to Xi'an with my family.
Where did you go over the Labour Day holiday?
examples.zh: 你劳动节假期去了哪里？

subject: 英语
title: Amazing places

pattern: What did you do (there)? I ... (动词过去式)
rule: 用 What did you do? 问别人过去做了什么，回答用动词过去式。

examples.en: What did you do there? Eat gingerbread?
examples.zh: 你在那里做了什么？吃姜饼吗？

subject: 英语
title: Amazing places

rule: 用 There is/are 表示某地有某物，单数用 is，复数用 are。

examples.en: There are over seven thousand clay warriors and horses.
examples.zh: 那里有七千多尊陶俑和陶马。

subject: 英语
title: Amazing places

pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
rule: 用 will 表示将来要做的事，比如 He'll meet a friend. 表示他将会见一个朋友。
subject: 英语
title: Amazing places

pattern: 主语 + should + 动词原形
rule: 用 should 表示建议，比如 You should go there! 表示你应该去那里！
subject: 英语
title: Amazing places

point: 一般过去时（Did 引导的一般疑问句）
pattern: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...? Yes, 主语 + did. / No, 主语 + didn't.
rule: 用 Did 开头问过去做过的事，回答用 Yes, ... did. 或 No, ... didn't.

examples.en: Did you count down to 12 o'clock?

subject: 英语
title: Getting together

point: 一般过去时（What did ... do? 询问过去做的事）
pattern: What did + 主语 + do (+ 时间/地点)?
rule: 用 What did ... do? 问别人过去做了什么。

examples.en: What did you do for the Spring Festival?
What did Binbin do last weekend?

subject: 英语
title: Getting together

point: 一般过去时（How was ...? 询问过去感受）
pattern: How was + 名词/活动? It was + 形容词.
rule: 用 How was ...? 问过去某事怎么样，回答用 It was + 形容词。

examples.en: How was your Mid-Autumn Festival holiday, Binbin?
examples.zh: 彬彬，你的中秋假期怎么样？
艾米，你周末过得怎么样？

subject: 英语
title: Getting together

point: 一般过去时（What did you like about it? 询问喜欢的方面）
pattern: What did you like about it? I liked + 名词/动名词.
rule: 用 What did you like about it? 问对方喜欢某事的哪方面，回答用 I liked ...。

examples.en: What did you like about it?
We shared ideas and talked about different books.
examples.zh: 我们分享想法并谈论不同的书。

subject: 英语
title: Getting together

point: 一般过去时（动词过去式变化）
pattern: 动词原形 → 过去式（如 clean→cleaned, go→went, do→did, see→saw）
rule: 讲过去的事时，动词要变成过去式，有的加 -ed，有的要变特殊形式。

examples.en: My dad and I cleaned the house.
examples.zh: 我爸爸和我打扫了房子。

examples.en: Xinxin and I pasted fu on the door.
examples.zh: 欣欣和我在门上贴了福字。

examples.en: My mother and I went to a marathon on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我和妈妈周日去了一场马拉松。

subject: 英语
title: Getting together

point: 情态动词 can 表将来意愿
pattern: Can I + 动词原形 + ...? Sure. / Yes, you can.
rule: 用 Can I ...? 请求许可或表达想一起做某事，回答用 Sure 或 Yes, you can。

examples.en: Can I join you next year?
examples.zh: 明年我能和你们一起吗？

examples.en: Sure. You can also join us for the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 当然可以。你也可以和我们一起过春节。

subject: 英语
title: Getting together

pattern: How do you feel? / How does ... feel? / What's the matter?
rule: 用 How do you feel? 或 What's the matter? 来问别人身体或心情怎么样。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy life

pattern: I have a ... / My ... hurts / I feel ...
rule: 用 I have a ... 说有什么病，用 My ... hurts 说哪里疼，用 I feel ... 说感觉如何。

examples.en: My head hurts and I have a runny nose.

subject: 英语
title: Healthy life

pattern: You should ... / You need to ... / You can ...
rule: 用 should, need to 或 can 来给别人提建议，后面加动词原形。

examples.en: You should drink some water and have a rest.
examples.zh: 你应该喝点水，休息一下。

examples.en: Maybe you should see a doctor.
We need to eat healthy food.
examples.zh: 我们需要吃健康的食物。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy life

pattern: I'm going to ... / ... is going to ...
rule: 用 be going to 加动词原形，表示打算或计划做某事。

examples.en: I'm going to the science museum tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天要去科学博物馆。

examples.en: My mum is going to take me to hospital this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午我妈妈要带我去医院。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy life

rule: 用动词的过去式或 was/were 来说过去发生的事情。

examples.en: My good friend Lucy moved to another city.
examples.zh: 我好朋友露西搬到了另一个城市。

examples.en: Miss White asked her, "What's the matter, Liu Jia?"
examples.zh: 怀特老师问她：“刘佳，怎么了？”

subject: 英语
title: Healthy life

rule: 用 be 加动词的 -ing 形式，表示正在发生的动作或状态。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy life

point: be going to 表示计划/打算
pattern: I'm going to ... / She is going to ... / He is going to ...
rule: 用 am/is/are going to 加动词原形，表示打算做某事。

examples.en: I'm going to buy a schoolbag.
She is going to buy a new schoolbag.
Mike is going to save up for a computer.
examples.zh: 迈克打算攒钱买一台电脑。

examples.en: I'm going to buy ... And I also want to buy ...

subject: 英语
title: Managing money well

point: want to do 表示想要做某事
pattern: I want to ... / She wants to ...
rule: 用 want to 加动词原形，表示想要做某事。

examples.en: I also want to buy some animal books.
She wants to buy a new schoolbag.
He also wants to buy a robot show ticket.
examples.zh: 他还想买一张机器人展的票。

subject: 英语
title: Managing money well

rule: need 后面可以直接加名词，也可以用 need to 加动词原形。

examples.en: Yes, you need a new one.

subject: 英语
title: Managing money well

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
pattern: She writes ... / She gets ... / She keeps ...
rule: 主语是 he/she/it 时，动词要加 s 或 es。

examples.en: She writes a spending plan every Sunday.
examples.zh: 她每个星期天写一份消费计划。

examples.en: Every week, she gets her pocket money.
examples.zh: 每周，她都会得到零花钱。

examples.en: She keeps her money in three money jars.
examples.zh: 她把钱放在三个存钱罐里。

examples.en: She uses this money to buy goods, like books.
examples.zh: 她用这笔钱买商品，比如书。

subject: 英语
title: Managing money well

point: use ... to do 表示用……来做某事
pattern: We use money to ... / She uses this money to ...
rule: use 后面加名词，再用 to 加动词原形，表示用某物做某事。

examples.en: We use money to buy goods.
We use money to pay for services.
She uses this money to buy goods, like books.
examples.zh: 她用这笔钱买商品，比如书。

examples.en: She also uses it to pay for services, like haircuts.
examples.zh: 她还用它来支付服务，比如理发。

subject: 英语
title: Managing money well

point: There was 表示过去存在
rule: 用 There was 表示过去有某样东西。

examples.en: There was shell money, knife money, copper coins, ...

subject: 英语
title: Managing money well

point: 询问与回答“能看到什么”
pattern: What can you see ...? / I can see ...
rule: 用 can 表示“能够看到”，后面接看到的事物。

examples.en: What can you see in the sky?
examples.zh: 你在天空中能看到什么？

examples.en: I can see buildings, a river, ...
examples.zh: 我能看到建筑物、一条河……

examples.en: We can see the Sun and clouds.
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
examples.zh: 在夜晚，我们能看到月亮和星星。

subject: 英语
title: Exploring space

point: There be 句型（单数/复数）
rule: 用 There is 表示“有”单数事物，用 There are 表示“有”复数事物。

examples.en: There are large oceans on Earth.
There isn't any life on it.

subject: 英语
title: Exploring space

point: 一般现在时（描述事实与习惯）
pattern: 主语 + 动词原形 / 动词第三人称单数形式
rule: 用一般现在时描述客观事实或经常发生的事情。

examples.en: Earth is a planet. It travels around the Sun.
examples.zh: 地球是一颗行星。它绕着太阳转。

examples.en: The Moon is my neighbour. It travels around me too.
examples.zh: 月亮是我的邻居。它也绕着我转。

examples.en: The Sun gives us light and keeps us warm.
The taikonauts get up early in the morning.
examples.zh: 航天员们早上很早起床。

subject: 英语
title: Exploring space

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
pattern: 主语 + can + 动词原形
rule: 用 can 表示“能够做某事”。

examples.en: We can see the Sun and clouds.
We can also see birds and planes.
examples.zh: 我们还能看到鸟和飞机。

examples.en: We can look into space with telescopes.
examples.zh: 我们可以用望远镜观察太空。

examples.en: They can't use water to wash their faces.

subject: 英语
title: Exploring space

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
pattern: 主语（单数）+ 动词加 s/es
rule: 主语是单数时，动词要加 s 或 es。

examples.en: It gives us light and keeps us warm.
It talks about things on Mars.
examples.zh: 它讲的是火星上的事物。

examples.en: It has a temperature of about 467°C.
examples.zh: 它的温度大约是467摄氏度。

subject: 英语
title: Exploring space

point: 疑问句：Is there any ...? / Are there any ...?
pattern: Is there any ...? / Are there any ...?
rule: 用 Is there any 询问单数事物是否存在，用 Are there any 询问复数事物是否存在。

examples.en: Is there any water on Mars?
Is there any life on the Sun?
Are there any ... around the Sun?

subject: 英语
title: Exploring space

point: 情态动词 should 表建议
rule: 用 should 加动词原形，表示“我们应该做某事”，用来提出建议。

examples.en: We should always unplug our computers and TVs.
examples.zh: 我们应该总是拔掉电脑和电视的插头。

examples.en: We should use air conditioners less.

subject: 英语
title: Energy, nature and us

point: 情态动词 can 表能力或建议
rule: 用 can 加动词原形，表示“我们可以做某事”，用来提出可行的做法。

examples.en: We can also use LED lighting.
We can go by bus or walk to ...
examples.zh: 我们可以坐公交车或步行去……
我们可以重复使用旧瓶子。

subject: 英语
title: Energy, nature and us

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
rule: 主语是第三人称单数时，疑问句用 does 开头，动词用原形。

examples.en: What does Binbin want to know about it?
examples.zh: 彬彬想知道关于它的什么？

examples.en: How much fresh water does Earth have?

page_hint: What do I want to kn
subject: 英语
title: Energy, nature and us

rule: 主语是 we/they 等复数时，动词用原形，表示经常或一般的情况。

examples.en: We use electricity to run a car, light a bulb, heat a room and cool a house.
examples.zh: 我们用电力来开车、点亮灯泡、加热房间和冷却房屋。

examples.en: We use green energy to light, heat and cool our homes and schools.
examples.zh: 我们用绿色能源来照明、加热和冷却我们的家和学校。

examples.en: We also use it to run cars, buses and trains.
examples.zh: 我们也用它来运行汽车、公交车和火车。

subject: 英语
title: Energy, nature and us

rule: 用 was/were 或动词过去式表示过去发生的事情。

examples.en: What did they choose for their project?
examples.zh: 他们为项目选择了什么？

subject: 英语
title: Energy, nature and us

rule: 用 There is/are 表示“有……”，is 用于单数，are 用于复数。

examples.en: There are many resources running out.

subject: 英语
title: Energy, nature and us

point: be going to 表示计划/打算
pattern: I'm going to ... / We're going to ...
rule: 用 am/is/are going to 加动词原形，表示已经计划好的事情。

examples.en: I'm going to visit the China Great Wall Museum.
examples.zh: 我打算去参观中国长城博物馆。

examples.en: We're going to plan some museum trips.
examples.zh: 我们打算计划一些博物馆之旅。

examples.en: Yes, I'm going to visit some museums online.
examples.zh: 是的，我打算在网上参观一些博物馆。

subject: 英语
title: Learning in museums

pattern: I want to ... / We want to ...
rule: 用 want to 加动词原形，表示想要做某事。

examples.en: I want to know about space and planets.
examples.zh: 我想知道关于太空和行星的事情。

examples.en: I want to learn more about staying healthy.
examples.zh: 我想更多地了解如何保持健康。

examples.en: I want to know more about Chinese festivals.
examples.zh: 我想更多地了解中国的节日。

subject: 英语
title: Learning in museums

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 加动词原形，表示能够做某事。

examples.en: We can read books or use the internet.
examples.zh: 我们可以读书或使用互联网。

examples.en: We can travel to different places.
examples.zh: 我们可以去不同的地方旅行。

examples.en: We can also learn in museums.
examples.zh: 我们也可以去博物馆学习。

subject: 英语
title: Learning in museums

pattern: What did you ...? / I saw ... / I went ...
rule: 用 did 提问，回答用动词过去式，表示过去发生的事情。

examples.en: What did you see in the museum?
examples.zh: 你在博物馆里看到了什么？
我看到了一艘大宇宙飞船。

examples.en: I also went into a mini space station.
examples.zh: 我还进入了一个迷你空间站。

examples.en: Did you see any other interesting things there?
examples.zh: 你在那里还看到其他有趣的东西吗？

subject: 英语
title: Learning in museums

rule: 用 was/were 表示过去的时间或状态。

examples.en: Chang'e is always sad, but she will be happy now.
examples.zh: 嫦娥总是很伤心，但现在她会开心了。

subject: 英语
title: Learning in museums

rule: 用 Is there 或 Are there 提问，表示某处有没有某物。
page_hint: What do you see in t
subject: 英语
title: Learning in museums

rule: 描述过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式。

examples.en: I ate some really tasty noodles.
examples.zh: 我吃了一些非常美味的面条。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 描述过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式。

examples.en: My parents and I, we had a sports day.
examples.zh: 我和父母一起过了一个运动日。

examples.en: We cleaned up at New Year.
examples.zh: 我们在新年时打扫了卫生。
我们穿上了红色的衣服。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: 主语 + should + 动词原形 + ...
rule: should 表示应该做某事。

examples.zh: 她应该得到充足的睡眠。

examples.en: We should talk about our feelings.
examples.zh: 我们应该谈谈我们的感受。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: 主语 + shouldn't + 动词原形 + ...
rule: shouldn't 表示不应该做某事。

examples.zh: 我们不应该感到如此悲伤。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 描述过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式。

examples.zh: 大卫买了一辆红色的自行车。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
rule: 用 Did 开头提问过去的事情，动词用原形。

examples.en: Did he use his money well?
Did she use her money well?

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/三单形式 + ...
rule: 描述现在的事实或习惯，动词用原形或三单形式。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: 主语 + need to + 动词原形 + ...
rule: need to 表示需要做某事。

examples.en: We need to use more solar power.
examples.zh: 我们需要使用更多的太阳能。

examples.en: We need to use more water power.
examples.zh: 我们需要使用更多的水力。

examples.en: We need to use much less water.
We need to turn off lights at night.

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 描述过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式。

examples.en: I visited the "Gingerbread House" last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我上个星期六去参观“姜饼屋”了。

examples.en: I went to Xi'an with my family.
We went to see the Terracotta Warriors.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What/Where/How + did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
rule: 用 did 提问过去的事情，后面的动词要用原形。

examples.en: Where did you go over the summer holidays, Binbin?

examples.zh: 你们在那儿做了些什么？

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 一般过去时的一般疑问句
pattern: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...? Yes, 主语 + did. / No, 主语 + didn't.
rule: 用 Did 开头提问，回答也用 did 或 didn't。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数 + ...
rule: 描述经常发生或现在的情况，主语是第三人称单数时动词要加 s 或 es。

examples.en: My head hurts and I have a runny nose.
The taikonauts get up early in the morning.
examples.zh: 中国航天员很早就起床。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: 主语 + can + 动词原形 + ...
rule: can 表示“能、会”，后面跟动词原形。

examples.en: What can you see in the sky?
examples.zh: 你能在天空中看到什么？

examples.en: We can see the Sun and clouds.
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
examples.zh: 在晚上，我们能看到月亮和星星。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: 主语 + should + 动词原形 + ...
rule: should 表示“应该”，后面跟动词原形。

examples.en: Maybe you should see a doctor.
We should use air conditioners less.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: 动词原形 → 过去式（如 go → went, have → had）
rule: 有些动词变过去式时不按规则加 -ed，要单独记住它们的过去式形式。
subject: 英语
title: lrregular verbs

pattern: What's your name? / My name's ... / I'm ...
rule: 用 What's your name? 问别人叫什么，回答可以说 My name's ... 或 I'm ...。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

point: 询问与回答国籍或来自哪里
pattern: Where are you from? / I'm from ... / Where is he/she from? / He's/She's from ...
rule: 用 Where are you from? 问对方来自哪里，回答用 I'm from ...；介绍别人时用 He's/She's from ...。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

rule: 用 Who's that ...? 问那个人是谁，回答用 That's ... 介绍。

examples.zh: 那是我们的新邻居艾米。

examples.en: That's my new neighbour, Mr Lin.
examples.zh: 那是我的新邻居林先生。

subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

point: 礼貌用语：请、谢谢、不客气、让我帮忙
pattern: After you. / Thank you. / You're welcome. / Let me help.
rule: 见面或排队时可以用 After you. 表示请；别人帮忙时说 Thank you.，对方回答 You're welcome.；想帮忙时说 Let me help.。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

pattern: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too. / Nice to see you. / Nice to see you too.
rule: 第一次见面用 Nice to meet you.，对方回应 Nice to meet you too.；再次见面用 Nice to see you.。
subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

point: 一般现在时（介绍身份与状态）
rule: 介绍人是谁、来自哪里、是什么身份时，用 is 或 are 连接。

examples.en: Miss White is my English teacher.
examples.zh: 怀特老师是我的英语老师。

subject: 英语
title: Meeting new people

rule: 用 is 或 has 来说一个东西长什么样、有什么。

examples.en: It's orange. It has a long tail and big ears.
examples.zh: 它是橙色的。它有一条长尾巴和大耳朵。

examples.en: Your dog is cute. It has a long body and short legs.
examples.zh: 你的狗很可爱。它身体长，腿短。

examples.en: I have a cat. He's old and fat, and he's also very slow.
examples.zh: 我有一只猫。它又老又胖，而且很慢。

examples.en: I love my rabbit. It has long ears and a short tail.
examples.zh: 我爱我的兔子。它有长耳朵和短尾巴。

subject: 英语
title: My words and actions

rule: 用 is 或 has 来说一个人长什么样、有什么。

examples.en: I have a good friend. His name is ...
examples.zh: 我有一个好朋友。他的名字是……

examples.en: I have a dog. It's thin. It has a long body. I like it.
examples.zh: 我有一只狗。它很瘦。它身体很长。我喜欢它。

subject: 英语
title: My words and actions

rule: 用动词原形来说我们做什么。
subject: 英语
title: My words and actions

rule: 用 love 来说我喜欢什么。
subject: 英语
title: My words and actions

rule: 用 can 来说我们能做什么。

examples.en: We can make animals with fruit.
examples.zh: 我们可以用水果做动物。

examples.en: We can be tall or short.
We can be fat or thin.

examples.zh: 我们还可以用水果“写字”。

subject: 英语
title: My words and actions

rule: 用 often 来说我经常做什么。

examples.en: I often make a card for my dad.
examples.zh: 我经常给我爸爸做卡片。

subject: 英语
title: My words and actions

point: 询问与回答物品（What's this? / What are these?）
pattern: What's this? It's a ... / What are these? They're ...
rule: 用 What's this? 问单数物品，用 It's a ... 回答；用 What are these? 问复数物品，用 They're ... 回答。

examples.zh: 这是什么？它是一支铅笔。
这些是什么？它们是葡萄。
这些是什么？它们是兔子。

page_hint: B 部分 Read, listen an
subject: 英语
title: Tools and senses for learning

point: 礼貌借用物品（Can I use your ..., please?）
pattern: Can I use your ..., please? Sure. / No problem. / Here you are.
rule: 用 Can I use your ..., please? 礼貌地借东西，对方可以用 Sure.、No problem. 或 Here you are. 回答。

examples.en: Can I use your pen? No problem.
examples.zh: 我能用一下你的钢笔吗？没问题。

examples.en: Excuse me. Can I use your eraser, please? Sure. Here you are.
examples.zh: 打扰一下，我能用一下你的橡皮吗？当然，给你。

examples.en: I can't find my ruler. Can I use your ruler, Zhang Peng? Sure. Here you are.
examples.zh: 我找不到我的尺子了。张鹏，我能用一下你的尺子吗？当然，给你。

subject: 英语
title: Tools and senses for learning

point: 用感官描述学习（I see/hear/smell/taste/touch with ...）
rule: 用 I + 感官动词 + with my + 身体部位，说明我用什么器官来学习。
subject: 英语
title: Tools and senses for learning

point: 用工具学习（I use ... / I can use ... to learn）
pattern: I use ... / I can use ... to learn.
rule: 用 I use ... 或 I can use ... to learn 说明我用什么工具来学习。

examples.en: I can use paper, pencils, books and computers to learn.
examples.zh: 我可以用纸、铅笔、书和电脑来学习。

subject: 英语
title: Tools and senses for learning

rule: 用动词原形开头，告诉别人做什么，比如 Read your book. 或 Put the pen in your pencil box.

examples.en: Put the pen in your pencil box.

subject: 英语
title: Tools and senses for learning

rule: 字母 i 在词尾前加 e 时，通常发长音 /aɪ/，如 like、bike、fine、size。
subject: 英语
title: Tools and senses for learning

point: 询问与表达想要的食物
pattern: Would you like some ...? / I'd like some ..., please.
rule: 用 Would you like some ...? 来问别人要不要某种食物；用 I'd like some ... 来说自己想吃某种食物。

examples.en: OK, Mum. I'd like some bread and eggs, please.
examples.zh: 好的，妈妈。我想要一些面包和鸡蛋。

examples.en: Would you like some rice and meat?
examples.zh: 你想要一些米饭和肉吗？

examples.en: I'd like some juice and noodles.
examples.zh: 我想要一些果汁和面条。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

point: 表达喜欢与爱好的食物
rule: 用 I like 或 I love 来说自己喜欢或喜爱的食物。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

pattern: Have some ... too. / Here you are.
rule: 用 Have some ... 来建议或提供某种食物；用 Here you are 把东西递给对方。

examples.en: Have some vegetables and fruit, John.
examples.zh: 约翰，吃点蔬菜和水果吧。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

point: 一般现在时（描述喜好与习惯）
rule: 用一般现在时来说平时喜欢吃什么或经常吃什么。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

point: 名词单复数与不可数名词
pattern: some + 可数名词复数 / 不可数名词
rule: some 后面可以接可数名词的复数，也可以接不可数名词。

examples.en: I'd like some bread and eggs.
examples.zh: 我想要一些面包和鸡蛋。

examples.en: I'd like some juice and noodles.
examples.zh: 我想要一些果汁和面条。

examples.en: Have some vegetables and fruit, John.
examples.zh: 约翰，吃点蔬菜和水果吧。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

point: 疑问句：What do you see / What do we eat
rule: 用 What do you/we ...? 来询问看到什么或吃什么。

examples.en: What food do you see in the picture?
examples.zh: 你在图片里看到什么食物？

subject: 英语
title: Healthy food

rule: 用 I have 来说自己有什么东西，some 后面跟复数名词。
subject: 英语
title: Old things

point: Do you have ...? 一般疑问句
pattern: Do you have ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you have 来问别人有没有某样东西，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.。

examples.en: Do you have any old school things?
examples.zh: 你有一些旧的学习用品吗？

examples.en: Yes, I do. I have some old books.
examples.zh: 是的，我有。我有一些旧书。

examples.en: Yes, I do. I have some pencils, ...
examples.zh: 是的，我有。我有一些铅笔……

subject: 英语
title: Old things

rule: 用 Where is 来问某物在哪里，回答用 It's 加介词 in、on、under 表示位置。
subject: 英语
title: Old things

pattern: Is it in/on/under ...? Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
rule: 用 Is it 加介词来问某物是否在某个位置，回答用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it isn't.。
subject: 英语
title: Old things

point: What's this? / What are these? 询问物品
pattern: What's this? It's a ... / What are these? They're ...
rule: 用 What's this 问单数物品，回答用 It's a ...；用 What are these 问复数物品，回答用 They're ...。
subject: 英语
title: Old things

point: 情态动词 can 表能力或许可
rule: 用 can 表示可以做某事或允许做某事。
subject: 英语
title: Old things

pattern: How many ... do you/we have? / How many ... do we need?
rule: 用 How many 来问有多少个可数东西，回答用数字或 I have ...。

examples.en: How many pencils do we have?
How many books do we have?
How many apples do we need?
How many boxes do we need?

subject: 英语
title: Numbers in life

pattern: How much is this/that ...? / How much is each ...?
rule: 用 How much 来问东西多少钱，回答用 It's ... yuan。

examples.en: How much is this toy car?

subject: 英语
title: Numbers in life

rule: 用 and 把两个数字加起来，用 makes 说出结果；Add one 表示再加一。
subject: 英语
title: Numbers in life

rule: 用数字加名词复数表示几个几是多少，如 Three fives are fifteen。
subject: 英语
title: Numbers in life

pattern: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty
rule: 11 到 20 的数字要会读会写，用来数东西、买东西和说时间。

examples.en: One, two ... eighteen, nineteen, twenty yuan.

subject: 英语
title: Numbers in life

pattern: I pay ... yuan for ... / I'll take ...
rule: 用 I pay ... yuan for ... 表示我花多少钱买什么；I'll take ... 表示我要买……个。

examples.en: I pay fifteen yuan for five books.
examples.zh: 我花十五元买了五本书。

examples.en: I pay three yuan for a ball.

subject: 英语
title: Numbers in life

pattern: How much is this/that/it? It's ... yuan.
rule: 用 How much is...? 来问东西多少钱，回答用 It's + 数字 + yuan。

examples.en: How much is this pencil box?

subject: 英语
title: Going to a school fair

rule: 用 How many...? 来问需要多少，后面接可数名词。
subject: 英语
title: Going to a school fair

pattern: What's your name? My name is ...
rule: 用 What's your name? 问别人叫什么名字，回答用 My name is + 名字。
subject: 英语
title: Going to a school fair

pattern: Where are you from? I'm from ...
rule: 用 Where are you from? 问别人来自哪里，回答用 I'm from + 国家/地方。
subject: 英语
title: Going to a school fair

rule: 用 It has + 名词 来描述某物或某人的特征。

examples.en: It has a long body and short legs.
examples.zh: 它有一个长身体和短腿。

examples.en: It has milk and cake for the fair.
examples.zh: 它有牛奶和蛋糕供集市使用。

subject: 英语
title: Going to a school fair

point: 情态动词 can 表请求或能力
rule: 用 Can...? 来请求许可或询问能力，回答可以用 Yes, please. 或 Sure. 表示同意。
subject: 英语
title: Going to a school fair

pattern: Where are you from? I'm from ...
rule: 用 Where are you from? 问别人来自哪里，用 I'm from ... 回答。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

point: 初次见面问候与自我介绍
pattern: Nice to meet you. What's your name? My name's ...
rule: 见面时先说 Nice to meet you.，再用 What's your name? 问名字，用 My name's ... 回答。

examples.en: Nice to meet you. What's your name?
examples.zh: 很高兴见到你。你叫什么名字？

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: Here's a seat. Please sit down.
rule: 用 Here's a seat. 表示有座位，再用 Please sit down. 请对方坐下。

examples.en: Here's a seat. Please sit down.

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: You are ... and you know it. ... it.
rule: 用 You are ... 描述状态，再用 and you know it 表示你知道，后面接动作。

examples.en: You are happy and you know it. Sing a song.
examples.zh: 你很开心，你也知道。唱首歌吧。

examples.en: You have long legs and you know it. Make them dance.
examples.zh: 你有长腿，你也知道。让它们跳舞吧。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: Can I use your ...? Yes, no problem. You can use ...
rule: 用 Can I use your ...? 请求借用，对方用 Yes, no problem. 同意，并说 You can use ...。

examples.en: Yes, no problem. You can use my pen.
examples.zh: 可以，没问题。你可以用我的笔。

examples.en: You can use it. You can use my ruler.
examples.zh: 你可以用它。你可以用我的尺子。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: Would you like some ...? Yes, I'd like some ...
rule: 用 Would you like some ...? 问对方要不要一些食物或饮料，用 Yes, I'd like some ... 回答。

examples.en: Yes, put it on my dish. Please, put it on my dish.
examples.zh: 是的，请把它放在我的盘子里。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 What's your name? 问别人叫什么名字，回答用 My name's 加名字。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: Where are you from? / I'm from ...
rule: 用 Where are you from? 问别人来自哪里，回答用 I'm from 加国家或地方。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 Who's that ...? 问那个人是谁，回答用 That's 加介绍。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 It has 加特征，描述一个东西有什么特点。

examples.en: It has a long body and short legs.
examples.zh: 它有长长的身体和短短的腿。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 一般现在时的一般疑问句
pattern: Do you ...? / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you 开头问别人是否做某事，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.

examples.en: Do you often say that to your mum?
examples.zh: 你经常对妈妈那么说吗？

examples.en: Yes, I do. I have some old books.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: How many ... do we have/need? / We have/need ...
rule: 用 How many 问有多少个，回答用 We have/need 加数量。

examples.en: How many books do we have?
How many boxes do we need?

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 What's he/she like? 问别人长什么样、性格怎么样，回答用 He/She's + 形容词。
subject: 英语
title: Different friends

rule: 用 can 表示会做某事，can't 表示不会做某事，后面直接加动词原形。
subject: 英语
title: Different friends

pattern: Is he/she good at ...? Yes, he/she is. / No, he/she isn't.
rule: 用 Is he/she good at ...? 问某人是否擅长某事，回答用 Yes, he/she is. 或 No, he/she isn't.。
subject: 英语
title: Different friends

rule: 用 has 表示某人拥有某种外貌特征，如 has short hair。

examples.en: The dog has a short tail.

subject: 英语
title: Different friends

rule: 用一般现在时描述某人经常做的事，动词要用第三人称单数形式。

examples.en: She helps a lot at home.
The dog likes to play in the rain.
examples.zh: 这只狗喜欢在雨中玩耍。

examples.en: He waits for the boy to come and play.

subject: 英语
title: Different friends

pattern: What can you do? I can ...
rule: 用 What can you do? 问别人会做什么，回答用 I can + 动词原形。

examples.en: What can you do for the festival?

subject: 英语
title: Different friends

pattern: How do you feel? / How does ... feel? / I'm ... / He's ... / She's ...
rule: 用 How do/does 问别人感觉，用 I'm/He's/She's 加情绪形容词回答。
subject: 英语
title: My feelings

pattern: What's the matter? / You look ... / I'm sorry. / Don't worry.
rule: 用 What's the matter? 问怎么了，用 You look + 情绪词 描述对方样子，再用 I'm sorry 或 Don't worry 安慰。

examples.en: You look sad. What's the matter?
examples.zh: 你看起来很伤心。怎么了？

subject: 英语
title: My feelings

pattern: I'm so worried! / I can't ... / It's about ...
rule: 用 I'm so worried! 表达担心，用 I can't 说不能做某事，用 It's about 说明事情原因。

examples.zh: 这是关于我们学校项目的事。

subject: 英语
title: My feelings

rule: 用 Why not 或 You can 或 Let's 提出建议，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: You can talk to him now.

subject: 英语
title: My feelings

pattern: I agree with ... / I don't agree with ... / We don't agree with each other.
rule: 用 agree with 表示同意某人，加 don't 表示不同意，用 each other 表示彼此。

examples.en: So you don't agree with each other?
My brother doesn't agree with me.
We don't agree with each other.
I need to talk to Mike.

subject: 英语
title: My feelings

pattern: I need to ... / It's important to ...
rule: 用 I need to 表示我需要做某事，用 It's important to 表示做某事很重要，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: I need to talk to Mike.
It's important to listen to each other.
It's important to try new things!
You need to listen to your friends.

subject: 英语
title: My feelings

pattern: What do you have on ...? I have ...
rule: 用 What do you have on + 星期 来问某天有什么课，回答用 I have + 科目。

examples.en: What do you have on Wednesdays?
I have Chinese, maths, music and PE.
examples.zh: 我有语文、数学、音乐和体育课。

examples.en: What do you have on Tuesdays?
I have maths, Chinese, art and English.
examples.zh: 我有数学、语文、美术和英语课。

subject: 英语
title: Work and play

rule: 用 What's your favourite subject? 问最喜欢的科目，回答用 It's + 科目。

examples.zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

subject: 英语
title: Work and play

pattern: What's your favourite day at school? It's ...
rule: 用 What's your favourite day at school? 问在学校最喜欢哪一天，回答用 It's + 星期。

examples.en: What's your favourite day at school?
examples.zh: 你在学校最喜欢哪一天？

examples.en: What's your favourite day at school?
examples.zh: 你在学校最喜欢哪一天？

subject: 英语
title: Work and play

point: 频率副词 usually / often / sometimes
pattern: I usually ... I often ... Sometimes I ...
rule: usually 表示通常，often 表示经常，sometimes 表示有时，放在动词前面说明做某事的频率。

examples.en: I often play football. Sometimes I play Chinese chess with my father.
examples.zh: 我经常踢足球。有时我和爸爸下中国象棋。

examples.en: I usually have pipa lessons on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我通常在星期天上琵琶课。

examples.en: I often play with my friends in the park.
examples.zh: 我经常和朋友们在公园里玩。

subject: 英语
title: Work and play

pattern: What do you do at the weekend? I usually ... I often ... Sometimes ...
rule: 用 What do you do at the weekend? 问周末做什么，回答用频率副词加动词短语。

examples.en: What do you do at the weekend?
I usually ... I often ... Sometimes I ...
What do you do at the weekend?

subject: 英语
title: Work and play

point: 一般现在时第三人称单数
rule: 主语是 he 或 she 时，动词要用第三人称单数形式，如 plays, does, has。

examples.en: He has music class on Wednesday and Thursday mornings.
examples.zh: 他星期三和星期四上午有音乐课。

examples.en: She often washes her clothes on Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 她经常在星期天下午洗衣服。

examples.en: She does her homework on Saturday mornings.
examples.zh: 她在星期六上午做作业。

examples.en: He doesn't lie down and works till light.
examples.zh: 他没有躺下，一直工作到天亮。

subject: 英语
title: Work and play

rule: 用 should 告诉别人应该做什么，表示建议。

examples.en: You should brush your teeth twice a day.

subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

rule: 用 shouldn't 告诉别人不应该做什么，表示不建议。

examples.en: You shouldn't play on a phone so often.
examples.zh: 你不应该这么频繁地玩手机。

examples.en: You shouldn't check your phone so often.
examples.zh: 你不应该这么频繁地看手机。

examples.en: You shouldn't eat too much honey, Zoom.

subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

rule: 用 Can I ...? 向别人请求做某事。

examples.en: Can I watch a TV show now, please?
examples.zh: 请问我现在可以看电视节目吗？

examples.en: Can I play on Mum's phone?
examples.zh: 我可以在妈妈的手机上玩吗？

subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

rule: 用 No, you can't. 回答别人不能做某事。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

rule: 用 has to 表示某人必须做某事。

examples.en: He has to stay at home.
Sarah has to do her homework.

subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

pattern: I ... every day / often / usually / sometimes
rule: 用一般现在时描述经常做的习惯，可加 every day、often、usually、sometimes 等词。

examples.en: I usually sleep about ten hours a day.
examples.zh: 我通常每天睡大约十个小时。

examples.en: I play with my friends every day.
examples.zh: 我每天和朋友们一起玩。

subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

rule: 用 don't 表示一般现在时的否定，说明不常做某事。

examples.en: I don't often eat green vegetables.
I don't spend too much time on it.
examples.zh: 我不在上面花太多时间。

examples.en: I don't always eat three meals a day.

subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

rule: 用 How can I ...? 询问自己可以怎么做。

examples.en: How can I take care of my teeth?
examples.zh: 我怎样才能照顾我的牙齿？

subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

rule: 用 There is ... 表示某处有某物。
subject: 英语
title: Healthy habits

pattern: What would you like to eat/drink?
rule: 用这个句型问别人想吃或喝什么。

examples.en: What would you like to eat?
What would you like to drink?

subject: 英语
title: Food we eat

rule: 用 I'd like 后面加食物或饮料，表示“我想要……”。

examples.en: I'd like a hamburger and some ice cream.
examples.zh: 我想要一个汉堡和一些冰淇淋。

subject: 英语
title: Food we eat

rule: 用 Can I have some ...? 礼貌地请求得到一些食物或饮料。

examples.en: Can I have some ice cream, please?
examples.zh: 我可以要一些冰淇淋吗？

subject: 英语
title: Food we eat

pattern: Where does ... come from? It comes from ...
rule: 用 Where does ... come from? 问食物来自哪里，用 It comes from ... 回答。

examples.en: Where does your coconut come from?
Where does your tea come from, Zip?
Most of my tea comes from China!
examples.zh: 我的大部分茶来自中国！

subject: 英语
title: Food we eat

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
rule: 主语是第三人称单数时，疑问句用 does，否定句用 doesn't，动词用原形。

examples.en: Does every plant have a seed?
No. Some plants don't have seeds at all!
examples.zh: 不。有些植物根本没有种子！

subject: 英语
title: Food we eat

rule: 用 There is 表示有单数或不可数名词，用 There are 表示有复数名词。

examples.en: There are many coconut trees there.
There is green tea, black tea, flower tea …

subject: 英语
title: Food we eat

rule: 用 There is 表示“有一个/有一些”，用 There are 表示“有多个/有一些”，后面接名词。

examples.en: There are many animals in the nature park.
examples.zh: 自然公园里有很多动物。

examples.en: There is a big forest in the park.
There are also many rivers in the nature park.
examples.zh: 自然公园里还有很多河流。

examples.en: There is a small shop in the hotel.

subject: 英语
title: Nature and us

point: 一般疑问句 Are there...? / Is there...?
pattern: Are there any ...? / Is there a ...?
rule: 用 Are there 或 Is there 开头提问，回答用 Yes, there are/is. 或 No, there aren't/isn't.。

examples.en: Are there any mountains in the nature park?
Is there a waterfall in the forest?

subject: 英语
title: Nature and us

rule: 用 will 表示将来会发生的事，There will be 表示“将会有……”。

examples.en: There will be heavy rain in the afternoon too.
There will be rain this afternoon.
I'll go to buy some umbrellas and raincoats.
examples.zh: 我会去买一些雨伞和雨衣。

subject: 英语
title: Nature and us

rule: 用 should 表示“应该做某事”，Don't 表示“不要做某事”。

examples.en: Don't go hiking in bad weather!
examples.zh: 不要在恶劣天气里去徒步！

examples.en: You should wear good hiking shoes.

subject: 英语
title: Nature and us

point: 一般现在时（描述自然与天气）
rule: 用一般现在时描述自然和天气的常态，如 There is heavy rain in summer.。

examples.en: There is heavy rain in summer.
There is often fog on the sea in spring.

subject: 英语
title: Nature and us

rule: 用 many 或 a lot of 表示“很多”，后面接可数名词复数。

examples.en: There are many animals in the nature park.
examples.zh: 自然公园里有很多动物。

examples.en: There are a lot of fish in the rivers.
There are many mountains, and there is a big forest.
examples.zh: 有很多山，还有一片大森林。

subject: 英语
title: Nature and us

point: 情态动词 can 表示能力
rule: 用 can 来说自己或我们能为派对做什么。

examples.en: I can choose the music for the party.
We can make some food for the party.
examples.zh: 我们可以为派对做一些食物。

examples.en: We can put on a play.

subject: 英语
title: New Year's party

rule: 用 Let's 来邀请大家一起做某事。

examples.zh: 我们办一个班级派对吧。

examples.en: Let's play the piano together, John.

subject: 英语
title: New Year's party

point: 一般现在时第三人称单数
rule: 说别人每周固定去某个俱乐部时，动词用第三人称单数形式。

examples.en: When does Chen Jie go to the Music Club?
examples.zh: Chen Jie 什么时候去音乐俱乐部？

examples.en: She goes to the Music Club on ...

subject: 英语
title: New Year's party

point: 一般将来时 be going to 表示计划
rule: 用 want to 来说自己想做的计划。

examples.en: I want to tell a story.

subject: 英语
title: New Year's party

point: 情态动词 should 表示建议
rule: 用 should 来给别人提建议。

examples.en: You should also eat healthy food and drink enough water.
examples.zh: 你也应该吃健康的食物，喝足够的水。

subject: 英语
title: New Year's party

point: 一般将来时 will 表示将来
rule: 用 will 来说将来会发生的事情。

examples.en: There will also be tests on Wednesday and Friday.
examples.zh: 周三和周五也会有考试。

subject: 英语
title: New Year's party

rule: 用 is 或 are 来说明人或事物的状态或特征。

examples.en: My friend Sam is happy again.
examples.zh: 我的朋友萨姆又开心了。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 There is 或 There are 来说明某处有某物。

examples.en: There is a waterfall, touching the sky.
There are flowers, starting to grow.

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 can 表示能够做某事。

examples.en: And we can drink some milk.
And we can drink some tea.

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用动词原形开头，表示建议或命令。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用动词原形或加 s 表示经常发生或习惯性的动作。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 is/are 加动词的 -ing 形式表示正在发生的动作。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

point: 询问对方状态/关心句型
rule: 看到对方情绪不对时，先描述样子，再问‘怎么回事’。

examples.en: You look sad. What's the matter?
examples.zh: 你看起来不开心。怎么回事？

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: have to 后面接动词原形，表示不得不做某事。

examples.en: We have to finish our project by Monday.
examples.zh: 我们得在星期一之前完成项目。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What's your favourite day at school?
rule: 用 What's your favourite... 来问对方最喜欢什么。

examples.en: What's your favourite day at school, John?
examples.zh: 你在学校最喜欢哪一天，约翰？

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 询问课程安排（一般现在时）
pattern: What do you have on ...? I have ...
rule: 用 What do you have 问有什么课，回答用 I have 加课程名。

examples.en: What do you have on Wednesdays?
I have Chinese, maths, music and PE.
examples.zh: 我有语文课、数学课、音乐课和体育课。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 频率副词 + 一般现在时
rule: often 表示经常，sometimes 表示有时，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: Sometimes I play Chinese chess with my father.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 第三人称单数一般疑问句
pattern: Does ... work on ...? Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
rule: 主语是第三人称单数时，用 Does 开头提问，回答用 does/doesn't。

examples.en: Does your mother work on both Saturdays and Sundays?
examples.zh: 你妈妈周六周日都工作吗？
是的，她（周末两天）都工作。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: Hello! / Hi! / What's your name? / I'm ... / My name is ... / Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
rule: 见面时先打招呼，再问或说自己的名字，最后互相说很高兴认识你。

examples.en: Hi! My name is Wu Binbin.
Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
examples.zh: 很高兴认识你。/ 我也很高兴认识你。

subject: 英语
title: Making friends

point: 一般现在时（第一人称陈述）
rule: 用 I 开头说“我”做什么，动词用原形。
subject: 英语
title: Making friends

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
rule: 说别人做什么时，动词要加 s 或 es。
subject: 英语
title: Making friends

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示“会、能”做某事，后面跟动词原形。

examples.en: I can greet people and show friendliness.
examples.zh: 我会向人打招呼并表现出友好。

examples.en: I can say the names of body parts.
examples.zh: 我会说出身体部位的名称。

examples.en: I can read, write and say Aa, Bb, Cc and Dd.
examples.zh: 我会读、写并说出 Aa、Bb、Cc 和 Dd。

subject: 英语
title: Making friends

point: 一般疑问句（Am I ...? / Are you ...?）
pattern: Am I ...? / Are you ...? Yes, I am! / Yes, you are!
rule: 用 Am I 或 Are you 开头提问，回答用 Yes, I am! 或 Yes, you are!

examples.en: Am I a good friend? Yes, I am!
examples.zh: 我是好朋友吗？是的，我是！

subject: 英语
title: Making friends

rule: 用动词原形开头，告诉别人做什么动作。
subject: 英语
title: Making friends

rule: 用 This is my ... 来介绍自己的家人或朋友。

examples.en: This is my friend, Sarah Miller.
examples.zh: 这是我的朋友，莎拉·米勒。

subject: 英语
title: Different families

pattern: Nice to meet you. / How do you do?
rule: 第一次见面时，用 Nice to meet you. 或 How do you do? 打招呼。

examples.en: Hi, Sarah. Nice to meet you.
This is my grandpa. How do you do?

subject: 英语
title: Different families

point: 询问对方和谁住在一起
rule: 用 Who lives with you? 问别人和谁住在一起。
subject: 英语
title: Different families

pattern: Is this your ...? / Is that your ...?
rule: 用 Is this your ...? 或 Is that your ...? 来问这是不是你的家人。
subject: 英语
title: Different families

pattern: Yes, it is. / No, it's my ...
rule: 回答 Is this/that ...? 时，用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it's my ...。
subject: 英语
title: Different families

pattern: I have a/an ... / I have two ...
rule: 用 I have ... 来说自己有什么家人。

examples.en: I have a brother, and a baby sister.
examples.zh: 我有一个哥哥，还有一个小妹妹。

subject: 英语
title: Different families

point: 询问与回答是否拥有宠物
pattern: Do you have a pet? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you have...? 问别人有没有某样东西，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.

examples.en: Yes, I do. I have a dog.

subject: 英语
title: Our animal friends

point: 一般现在时陈述句（I have / I like）
rule: 用 I have 表示“我有”，用 I like 表示“我喜欢”，后面直接加名词或名词短语。
subject: 英语
title: Our animal friends

point: What's this? / What's that? 询问物品
pattern: What's this? / What's that? It's a/an ...
rule: 用 What's this? 问近处的东西，用 What's that? 问远处的东西，回答用 It's a/an ...

examples.zh: 这是什么？它是一头大象。
那是什么？它是一只狐狸。
这是什么？它是一只猴子。
这是什么？它是一只熊猫。

subject: 英语
title: Our animal friends

point: There be 句型（描述动物特征）
rule: 用 The + 动物 + is + 形容词 来描述动物的特点，如 tall, fast, big, small。
subject: 英语
title: Our animal friends

point: 情态动词 can 表示能力
rule: 用 can 表示“能够”，后面加动词原形，如 sing, eat。
subject: 英语
title: Our animal friends

pattern: Do you like ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't. I like ...
rule: 用 Do you like 开头问别人喜不喜欢某物，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.，并说出自己喜欢的东西。

examples.en: No, I don't. I like bananas.
examples.zh: 不，我不喜欢。我喜欢香蕉。

subject: 英语
title: Plants around us

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示“能够、可以”做某事，后面直接加动词原形。
subject: 英语
title: Plants around us

point: 一般现在时（描述植物需要）
pattern: Plants need ... / ... need air, water and sun.
rule: 用 need 表示“需要”，主语是复数或第三人称单数时，need 不变或加 s。

examples.en: Plants need air, water and sun.
examples.zh: 植物需要空气、水和阳光。

examples.en: Flowers need air, water and sun.
The apple trees need air, water and sun.
examples.zh: 苹果树需要空气、水和阳光。

examples.en: I need air, water and sun.

subject: 英语
title: Plants around us

point: 一般现在时（描述植物能给予）
pattern: Plants can give us ... / I give ... to ...
rule: 用 give 表示“给予”，后面接给的东西和接受的人。

examples.en: Plants can give us many things.
examples.zh: 植物能给我们很多东西。

examples.en: I give apples to my family.
Trees grow and give us things.
What do we get from plants?
examples.zh: 我们从植物那里得到什么？

subject: 英语
title: Plants around us

rule: 用 are 连接主语和形容词，描述事物的特征，so 表示“非常”。
subject: 英语
title: Plants around us

point: 指示代词 this 与 be 动词
rule: 用 This is 介绍某物，用 I am 介绍自己。

examples.en: I am an apple tree. My new family help me.
examples.zh: 我是一棵苹果树。我的新家人帮助我。

subject: 英语
title: Plants around us

pattern: What colour is it? / What colour is ...?
rule: 用来问某样东西是什么颜色，回答时用 It's ... 或 ... is ...。
subject: 英语
title: The colourful world

rule: 用 is 或 are 来说某样东西是什么颜色。
subject: 英语
title: The colourful world

pattern: What colours do you like? / I like ...
rule: 用来问别人喜欢什么颜色，回答时用 I like ...。

examples.en: I like yellow, red and blue.
examples.zh: 我喜欢黄色、红色和蓝色。

subject: 英语
title: The colourful world

rule: 用 I see ... 来说自己看见了什么颜色或事物。

examples.en: I see colours here and there.
Purple flowers, green grass and blue sea.
examples.zh: 紫色的花，绿色的草和蓝色的海。

subject: 英语
title: The colourful world

rule: 用 ... and ... make ... 来说两种颜色混合会变成什么颜色。

examples.zh: 红色和蓝色混合变成紫色。
蓝色和黄色混合变成绿色。

subject: 英语
title: The colourful world

rule: 用 ... can say "..." 来说某种颜色代表什么含义。
subject: 英语
title: The colourful world

pattern: How old are you? / How old is ...?
rule: 用 How old 来问别人或别人家的人几岁，回答用 I'm ... years old. 或 He/She is ... years old.

examples.en: Hello, Xiaoli! How old are you?

subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

rule: 用 How many 来问有多少个东西，后面接可数名词复数，回答用数字。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

pattern: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten
rule: 用这些单词表示一到十的数量，可以数东西、说年龄、说价格。

examples.en: One head, two legs, ten toes.
examples.zh: 一个头，两条腿，十个脚趾。

examples.en: One head, eight eyes, eight legs.
examples.zh: 一个头，八只眼睛，八条腿。

examples.en: One head, four wings, six legs.
examples.zh: 一个头，四只翅膀，六条腿。

subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

pattern: I'm ... years old. / He/She is ... years old.
rule: 用 I'm 或 He/She is 加数字加 years old 来说自己或别人几岁。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

pattern: I have ... yuan. / That's ... yuan, please.
rule: 用 I have 加数字加 yuan 来说自己有多少钱，用 That's ... yuan, please. 来说一共多少钱。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

rule: 用 It's 加数字加 o'clock 来说现在几点整。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

rule: 用 This is 来介绍身边的人或物。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
rule: 第一次见面时说 Nice to meet you，对方回应 Nice to meet you too。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: Do you like ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you like 来问别人喜不喜欢某样东西，回答用 Yes, I do 或 No, I don't。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示“能够、可以”做某事。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

rule: 用 Be 开头告诉别人要怎么做，后面加 please 表示礼貌。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: What's this? / Is that a ...? It's a ...
rule: 用 What's this 问“这是什么”，用 Is that 问“那是……吗”，回答用 It's a ...。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you, my new friend.
rule: 第一次见到新朋友时，用这句话打招呼，表示很高兴认识对方。

examples.en: Nice to meet you, my new friend.
examples.zh: 很高兴认识你，我的新朋友。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 This is my ... 来介绍自己的家人是谁。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 I am with my ... 表示自己和家人在一起。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 Where are you? 问对方在哪里。

examples.en: Daddy Finger, Daddy Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 爸爸手指，爸爸手指，你在哪里？

examples.en: Mummy Finger, Mummy Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 妈妈手指，妈妈手指，你在哪里？

examples.en: Grandpa Finger, Grandpa Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 爷爷手指，爷爷手指，你在哪里？

examples.en: Grandma Finger, Grandma Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 奶奶手指，奶奶手指，你在哪里？

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 A ... says "..." 来说某种动物会发出什么声音。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

point: 情态动词 can 表示能力
pattern: I can ... / They can ... / We can ...
rule: 用 can 表示“会、能够”做某事。

examples.en: I can count up from one to ten.

subject: 英语
title: Songs

pattern: Show me a/an ...! / Say ...! / Sit down, ...! / Get up and ...!
rule: 用动词原形开头，表示让别人做某事，句末加感叹号。

examples.en: Say E, F, G and H!

subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

rule: 主语是单数时，用 is 表示“是”，后面可以接名词、形容词或介词短语。
subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

point: 一般现在时（has 表示“有”）
rule: 主语是单数时，用 has 表示“有”，后面接名词。
subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数动词）
rule: 主语是第三人称单数时，动词要加 s 或 es，如 win 变成 wins。

examples.en: His job is to fly a jet.
examples.zh: 他的工作是驾驶喷气式飞机。

subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

rule: 用 I see 表示“我看到……”，后面接看到的东西。

examples.en: I see an apple in a bag.
examples.zh: 我看到袋子里有一个苹果。

examples.en: I see Bob in the bed.
I see a cat and a can.
examples.zh: 我看到一只猫和一个罐子。

examples.en: I see a pen and a cup.
examples.zh: 我看到一支笔和一个杯子。

subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

rule: 介词放在名词前，表示位置或伴随关系，如 in a bag 表示“在袋子里”。

examples.en: I see an apple in a bag.
examples.zh: 我看到袋子里有一个苹果。

examples.en: I see Bob in the bed.
Number six is on the box.

subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

pattern: Hello! I'm ... / Hi! My name is ... / Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
rule: 见面打招呼时，用 I'm 或 My name is 介绍自己，用 Nice to meet you 表示初次见面很高兴。

examples.en: Hi! My name is Wu Binbin.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: This is my ... / Is that your ...? / Yes, it is.
rule: 用 This is 介绍身边的人或物，用 Is that 询问远处的人或物，回答用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it isn't.。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 一般现在时（Do 引导的一般疑问句）
pattern: Do you ...? / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you 开头提问别人是否做某事，肯定回答 Yes, I do.，否定回答 No, I don't.。

examples.en: Yes, I do. I have a cat.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What's this? / What's that? / It's a ...
rule: 用 What's this 问近处的东西，用 What's that 问远处的东西，回答用 It's a 加名词。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What colour is it? / It's ... / What colours do you like? / I like ...
rule: 用 What colour is it 问颜色，回答用 It's 加颜色词；用 What colours do you like 问喜欢的颜色，回答用 I like 加颜色词。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: How old are you? / I'm ... years old. / How many ...? / ...
rule: 用 How old are you 问年龄，回答用 I'm 加数字加 years old；用 How many 问数量，回答直接说数字。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 询问与回答能力（can 句型）
pattern: Can you/... help? Yes, ... can. ... can ...
rule: 用 Can 开头问别人能不能做某事，回答用 Yes, ... can. 后面再接能做的动作。

examples.en: Can you help? Yes, I can. I can clean my room.
examples.zh: 你能帮忙吗？是的，我能。我能打扫我的房间。

examples.en: Can she help? Yes, she can. She can do some chores.
examples.zh: 她能帮忙吗？是的，她能。她能做些家务。

examples.en: Can he help? Yes, he can. He can sweep the floor.
examples.zh: 他能帮忙吗？是的，他能。他能扫地。

examples.en: Can we help? Yes, we can. That's for sure!
examples.zh: 我们能帮忙吗？是的，我们能。那是肯定的！

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

rule: 用 What's ... job? 问某人的工作，回答用 He's/She's a 加职业名词。

examples.en: What's your mother's job? She's a doctor.
examples.zh: 你妈妈的工作是什么？她是一名医生。

examples.en: What's your father's job? He's a factory worker.
examples.zh: 你爸爸的工作是什么？他是一名工厂工人。

examples.en: What's Mike's job? He's a doctor.
examples.zh: Mike 的工作是什么？他是一名医生。

examples.en: What's your mother's job? She's a teacher.
examples.zh: 你妈妈的工作是什么？她是一名老师。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

point: 一般现在时（描述家庭日常）
rule: 用一般现在时描述经常做的家务，主语是 I/We 时动词用原形。

examples.en: We cook together. We are happy together.
examples.zh: 我们一起做饭。我们一起很开心。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

point: There be 句型（描述家庭情况）
rule: 用 There is/are 来说家里有什么人或物，单数用 is，复数用 are。

examples.en: You have a big family. Is this your father?
examples.zh: 你有一个大家庭。这是你爸爸吗？

examples.en: Yes, it is. He's a PE teacher.
examples.zh: 是的，他是。他是一名体育老师。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

pattern: doctor, nurse, farmer, factory worker, office worker
rule: 这些词表示不同职业，注意 factory worker 和 office worker 是复合名词。

examples.en: Doctors are great! My father is a doctor too.
examples.zh: 医生们很棒！我爸爸也是一名医生。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

pattern: What do you do with your family? I often ...
rule: 用 What do you do with your family? 问和家人一起做什么，回答用 I often 加动词原形。

examples.en: What do you do with your family?
examples.zh: 你和你的家人一起做什么？

examples.en: What do you do with your family? Do a survey.
examples.zh: 你和你的家人一起做什么？做个调查。

subject: 英语
title: Helping at home

point: 描述外貌特征（be + 形容词）
rule: 用 is 加形容词来描述朋友的外貌或性格，比如高、矮、强壮、安静等。
subject: 英语
title: My friends

point: 描述外貌特征（have/has + 名词）
rule: 用 has 加名词来描述朋友拥有的外貌特征，比如头发、眼睛等。

examples.en: He has nice short hair too.
He has small eyes and very big ears.
examples.zh: 他有小眼睛和非常大的耳朵。

subject: 英语
title: My friends

pattern: What's his/her name? His/Her name is ...
rule: 用 What's his/her name? 询问朋友的名字，用 His/Her name is ... 来回答。

examples.en: Who is she? Her name is Sarah.
What's his/her name? His/Her name is ...
examples.zh: 他/她的名字是什么？他/她叫……

subject: 英语
title: My friends

point: 描述经常做的事情（often + 动词）
rule: 用 often 加动词原形来描述朋友经常做的事情，比如读书、玩游戏、帮助等。

examples.en: He often helps me with English.
She often reads books with me.

subject: 英语
title: My friends

point: 第三人称单数动词变化
rule: 当主语是 he 或 she 时，动词后面要加 s 或 es，比如 plays, reads, helps。

examples.en: My friend plays games with me.
examples.zh: 我的朋友和我一起玩游戏。

examples.en: My friend plays football with me.
examples.zh: 我的朋友和我一起踢足球。

examples.en: My friend helps me with English.

subject: 英语
title: My friends

point: 描述共同活动（play/help + 名词 + with）
rule: 用 play 或 help 加名词，再用 with 表示和某人一起做某事或帮助某人做某事。

examples.en: I help my friend with Chinese.

subject: 英语
title: My friends

rule: 用 There is 表示“有一个……”，用 There are 表示“有一些……”，后面接地点或事物。

examples.en: There are books, pencils and clothes.

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

pattern: What is this place? / What do people do here?
rule: 用 What is this place? 问“这是什么地方”，用 What do people do here? 问“人们在这里做什么”。
subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

pattern: I often ... there. / We often ... there.
rule: 用 often 表示“经常”，后面接动词原形，说明经常在某地做某事。

examples.en: I often play there with my friends.
examples.zh: 我经常和朋友们在那里玩。

examples.en: I often take a walk there.
We often play in the park.

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

rule: 用 can 表示“能够、可以”，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: I can read stories about them.
examples.zh: 我可以读关于它们的故事。
孩子们可以在那里玩得开心。

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

rule: 用 There is also 表示“还有一个……”，用来补充说明另一个事物。

examples.en: There is also a nice park over there.
examples.zh: 那边还有一个漂亮的公园。

examples.en: There is also a nice shop.

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

rule: 用 There are 加多个名词，用 and 连接，表示“有……和……”。

examples.en: There are books, pencils and clothes.
There are many old things and photos.
There are nice people and great places here.
examples.zh: 这里有很好的人和很棒的地方。

subject: 英语
title: Places we live in

rule: 用 is/are 加动词的 -ing 形式，表示现在正在做的事情。

examples.en: Chen Jie is making the bed.
Binbin and John are telling funny stories.
examples.zh: 彬彬和约翰正在讲有趣的故事。

examples.en: She is helping some students cross the road.
examples.zh: 她正在帮助一些学生过马路。

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

point: 一般现在时（描述职业与日常行为）
rule: 用 is a/an 加职业名词介绍身份，再用一般现在时动词描述他/她常做的事。

examples.en: He's a cleaner. He cleans the community.
examples.zh: 他是一名清洁工。他打扫社区。

examples.en: Our neighbour is a firefighter. He often helps people.
examples.zh: 我们的邻居是一名消防员。他经常帮助人们。

examples.en: He's a school bus driver. He takes us to school every day.
examples.zh: 他是一名校车司机。他每天送我们去学校。

examples.en: She's a nurse. She helps people.
examples.zh: 她是一名护士。她帮助人们。

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

pattern: What jobs are important in a community? / You're a ... .
rule: 用 What jobs are important... 询问社区里哪些工作重要，用 You're a ... 说出对方的职业。

examples.en: What jobs are important in a community?
examples.zh: 社区里哪些工作是重要的？

examples.en: My neighbour is a police officer. She helps a lot of people.
examples.zh: 我的邻居是一名警察。她帮助很多人。

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

rule: 用 There is 表示有一个，There are 表示有一些，后面接名词。

examples.en: There are three elephants in the photo.
There is a big lake in the park.

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

rule: 用 can 表示能够做某事，后面加动词原形。

examples.en: I can sing for old people, or tell stories for kids!
examples.zh: 我可以为老人唱歌，也可以为孩子们讲故事！

examples.en: You can all help old people.

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

rule: 用 Don't 加动词原形，表示不要做某事，用来提醒安全。

examples.en: Don't swim there. It's not safe.
examples.zh: 不要在那里游泳。那不安全。

examples.en: Don't cross at a red light!

subject: 英语
title: Helping in the community

rule: 用这个句型问某个地方的天气怎么样。

examples.en: What's the weather like in Beijing?
What's the weather like in Sydney?
What's the weather like in Harbin?

subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用 It's 加天气形容词来描述天气，两个形容词之间用 and 连接。
subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示能做什么，用 can't 表示不能做什么。

examples.zh: 我们不能在外面踢足球。

subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用这个句型问在某种天气下我们能做什么。
subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用 There is 表示某处有某物，这里用来描述天气现象。
subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

rule: 用 be 动词加动词的 -ing 形式表示正在发生的动作。

examples.en: The boy is having fun in the snow.
examples.zh: 那个男孩正在雪里玩得开心。

examples.en: They're playing football on the grass.
examples.zh: 他们正在草地上踢足球。

examples.en: The boy is flying a kite and smiling.
examples.zh: 那个男孩正在放风筝并微笑。

examples.en: They're making a snowman and having a snowball fight.
examples.zh: 他们正在堆雪人并打雪仗。

subject: 英语
title: The weather and us

pattern: Whose ... is it? / Whose ... are these? It's ...'s. / They're ...'s.
rule: 用 Whose 问“这是谁的”，回答用名词所有格（人名后加 's）表示所属。

examples.en: Whose sweater is it? It's Lu Wei's.
examples.zh: 这是谁的毛衣？是陆伟的。

examples.en: Whose shirts are these? They're Xiao Fei's.
examples.zh: 这些衬衫是谁的？是小飞的。

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

rule: 在人名或物主代词后加 's 表示“……的”，mine、yours 等是名词性物主代词，单独使用。

examples.zh: 这条紫色裙子是妈妈的。
这件绿色毛衣是迈克的。

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 询问季节喜好（Which season do you like?）
pattern: Which season do you like? ... I like ... . I can ... .
rule: 用 Which season do you like? 问对方喜欢哪个季节，回答先说喜欢的季节，再用 I can 说能做的事。

examples.en: Which season do you like? Winter. I can make a snowman.
examples.zh: 你喜欢哪个季节？冬天。我可以堆雪人。

examples.en: Sarah, which season do you like?
I like winter too. There are many festivals.
examples.zh: 我也喜欢冬天。有很多节日。

examples.en: I like spring. It's warm and windy.
examples.zh: 我喜欢春天。它温暖又多风。

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: can 后面加动词原形，表示“能、会”做某事。

examples.en: I can go to the park and fly kites.
I can wear my pink sweater.
examples.zh: 我可以穿我的粉色毛衣。

examples.en: You can go to the beach on Christmas Day?
examples.zh: 你圣诞节可以去海滩吗？

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 一般现在时（描述季节特征与习惯）
pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/三单形式（如 Spring is green. It snows a lot.）
rule: 用一般现在时描述季节的特点和经常做的事，第三人称单数动词要加 s。

examples.en: Spring is green. It's full of life.
examples.zh: 春天是绿色的。它充满生机。

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

rule: 用 There is/are 表示“有……”，is 后接单数，are 后接复数。

examples.en: There are many festivals. My family and I often get together and have fun.
examples.zh: 有很多节日。我的家人和我经常聚在一起玩得开心。

subject: 英语
title: Changing for the seasons

point: 情态动词 can 表能力/建议
rule: 用 can 表示“能、可以”做某事，后面接动词原形。

examples.en: We can go to the park and give out some posters.
examples.zh: 我们可以去公园发一些海报。

examples.en: We can also water the plants.
examples.zh: 我们还可以给植物浇水。

subject: 英语
title: Let's help!

examples.zh: 这就是她打扫房间的方式。

examples.zh: 这就是他打扫房间的方式。

examples.zh: 我们可以做我们喜欢的事。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

examples.zh: 我经常打扫房间和洗衣服。

examples.zh: 有时我和张鹏打乒乓球。

subject: 英语

subject: 英语

examples.en: Apples and oranges make you strong.

subject: 英语

subject: 英语

subject: 英语
title: The colourful world

rule: 用 and 连接两种颜色，make 表示混合后变成什么颜色。

examples.zh: 红色和蓝色混合变成紫色。
蓝色和黄色混合变成绿色。

subject: 英语

subject: 英语
