subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

rule: 用 How many 来问有多少个某物，后面接可数名词复数，回答用数字。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

pattern: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten
rule: 用这些单词表示 1 到 10 的数量，可以数东西、说年龄、说时间。

examples.en: One head, two legs, ten toes.
examples.zh: 一个头，两条腿，十个脚趾。

examples.en: One head, eight eyes, eight legs.
examples.zh: 一个头，八只眼睛，八条腿。

examples.en: One head, four wings, six legs.
examples.zh: 一个头，四只翅膀，六条腿。

examples.en: One orange, two apples and three bananas.
examples.zh: 一个橙子，两个苹果和三个香蕉。

subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

rule: 用 I'm 加数字加 years old 来说自己的年龄。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

rule: 用 It's 加数字加 o'clock 来说几点整。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

pattern: I have ... yuan. / That's ... yuan, please.
rule: 用 I have 加数字加 yuan 来说自己有多少钱，用 That's ... yuan, please 来说多少钱。
subject: 英语
title: Useful numbers

rule: 用 This is 来介绍身边的人或物。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
rule: 第一次见面时说 Nice to meet you，对方回应 Nice to meet you too。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: Do you like ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you like 来问别人喜不喜欢某样东西，回答用 Yes, I do 或 No, I don't。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示“能够、可以”做某事。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

rule: 用 Be 开头告诉别人要怎么做，后面加 please 表示礼貌。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: What's this? / Is that a ...? It's a ...
rule: 用 What's this 问“这是什么”，用 Is that 问“那是……吗”，回答用 It's a ...。
subject: 英语
title: Being a good guest

pattern: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you, my new friend.
rule: 第一次见到新朋友时，用这句话打招呼，表示很高兴认识对方。

examples.en: Nice to meet you, my new friend.
examples.zh: 很高兴认识你，我的新朋友。

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 This is my ... 来介绍自己的家人是谁。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 I am with my ... 表示自己和家人在一起。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 Where are you? 问对方在哪里。

examples.en: Daddy Finger, Daddy Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 爸爸手指，爸爸手指，你在哪里？

examples.en: Mummy Finger, Mummy Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 妈妈手指，妈妈手指，你在哪里？

examples.en: Grandpa Finger, Grandpa Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 爷爷手指，爷爷手指，你在哪里？

examples.en: Grandma Finger, Grandma Finger, where are you?
examples.zh: 奶奶手指，奶奶手指，你在哪里？

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 A ... says "..." 来说某种动物会发出什么声音。
subject: 英语
title: Songs

point: 情态动词 can 表示能力
pattern: I can ... / They can ... / We can ...
rule: 用 can 表示“会、能够”做某事。

examples.en: I can count up from one to ten.

subject: 英语
title: Songs

rule: 用 Show me 开头，后面加 a 或 an 加一个字母或物品，表示“给我看一个……”。
subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

rule: After me 表示“跟我读”，后面跟要读的字母；Say 后面跟要说的字母或单词。

examples.en: After me. A, B, C, D!
Say E, F, G and H!
Say it well. I, J, K and L!
Say it with me. M, N, O, P!

subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

point: 祈使句（Sit down / Get up and run）
rule: 动词开头，表示命令或建议，句末用感叹号。
subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

rule: 主语是单数时，用 is 表示“是”。
subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

point: 一般现在时（be动词 is 表状态/颜色）
rule: 用 The + 名词 + is + 形容词，描述事物的状态或颜色。

examples.en: The girl is hot in the hat.

subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

point: 一般现在时（has 表拥有）
rule: 主语是单数时，用 has 表示“有”。
subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

rule: 用 I see 表示“我看见”，后面加看见的东西。

examples.en: I see an apple in a bag.
examples.zh: 我看见袋子里有一个苹果。

examples.en: I see Bob in the bed.
I see a cat and a can.
examples.zh: 我看见一只猫和一个罐子。

examples.en: I see a pen and a cup.
examples.zh: 我看见一支笔和一个杯子。

subject: 英语
title: Chants in "Letters and sounds"

pattern: Hello! I'm ... / Hi! My name is ... / Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
rule: 见面打招呼时，用 I'm 或 My name is 介绍自己，用 Nice to meet you 表示初次见面很高兴。

examples.en: Hi! My name is Wu Binbin.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: This is my ... / Is that your ...? / Yes, it is.
rule: 用 This is 介绍身边的人或物，用 Is that 询问远处的人或物，回答用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it isn't.。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: Do you ...? / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you 开头提问对方是否做某事或拥有某物，肯定回答 Yes, I do.，否定回答 No, I don't.。

examples.en: Yes, I do. I have a cat.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What's this? / What's that? / It's a ... / What colour is it? / It's ...
rule: 用 What's this/that 询问近处或远处的物品，用 It's a 回答；用 What colour is it 询问颜色，直接用颜色词回答。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: How old are you? / I'm ... years old. / How many ...? / ...
rule: 用 How old are you 问年龄，用 I'm ... years old 回答；用 How many 问数量，直接用数字回答。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 情态动词 can 表能力
rule: 用 can 表示“能够、可以”，后面直接加动词原形，说明某人或某物具备某种能力。

examples.en: Plants can give us many things.
examples.zh: 植物能为我们提供很多东西。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 What's your ...'s job? 问别人的工作，回答用 She's/He's a + 职业。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What's your friend's name? / His/Her name is ...
rule: 用 What's your friend's name? 问朋友的名字，回答用 His/Her name is + 名字。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 He's/She's + 形容词 描述外貌或性格，两个形容词用 and 连接，also 表示“也”。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 There is 表示“有”单数或不可数名词，用 There are 表示“有”复数名词。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: We can ... / Can I ...? / We can't ...
rule: 用 can 表示“能、可以”，后面加动词原形；can't 表示“不能”。

examples.zh: 我们可以做一些家务活。

examples.en: We can't play basketball in the park.
examples.zh: 我们不能在公园打篮球了。

examples.en: We can go to the library.
Can I wear this new shirt today?
examples.zh: 我今天可以穿这件新衬衫吗？

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 be 动词（am/is/are）加动词的 -ing 形式表示正在发生的动作。

examples.en: Chen Jie is making the bed.
John and Class One are singing songs together.
examples.zh: 约翰和一班（的孩子们）在一起唱歌。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: Do you ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you 开头问别人做不做某事，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

pattern: Is that your ...? Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
rule: 用 Is that 开头问那是不是一样东西，回答用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it isn't.
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

rule: 用 What colour 问别人喜欢什么颜色。
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

point: 特殊疑问句 What's your name?
rule: 用 What's your name? 问别人叫什么名字，回答用 My name's ...
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

rule: 用 Where is 问东西在哪里，回答用 It's ... 说明位置。
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

pattern: How many ... do you have? I have ...
rule: 用 How many 问有多少个，回答用 I have ... 说数量。

examples.en: How many books do you have?

subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

pattern: How tall are you? / How tall is it?
rule: 用 How tall 来问人或物有多高，回答用 I’m ... metres 或 It’s ... metres。
subject: 英语
title: How tall are you?

pattern: How heavy are you? / How heavy is it?
rule: 用 How heavy 来问人或物有多重，回答用 I’m ... kilograms 或 It’s ... tons。
subject: 英语
title: How tall are you?

rule: 用 What size 来问鞋子的尺码，回答用 My shoes are size ... 或 Size ...。

examples.en: In China I wear size 40 shoes.

subject: 英语
title: How tall are you?

rule: 用形容词的比较级加 than 来比较两个人或物，比如 taller than, heavier than, older than。

examples.en: It’s taller than both of us together.
examples.zh: 它比我们两个加起来还高。

examples.en: Your feet are bigger than mine.

subject: 英语
title: How tall are you?

rule: 用 There is 或 There are 来说某处有某物，is 用于单数，are 用于复数。

examples.en: There are more dinosaurs over there!

subject: 英语
title: How tall are you?

rule: 用 How old 来问年龄，回答用 I’m ... years old。

rule: 表示过去发生的事情，规则动词一般在词尾加 -ed，如 talk→talked, stay→stayed, live→lived, want→wanted, plan→planned, cry→cried。
subject: 英语
title: Last weekend

point: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
rule: 有些动词的过去式要特殊记，如 saw, slept, had, went, fell, hurt。

examples.en: I fell off my bike and hurt my foot.
examples.zh: 我从自行车上摔下来，弄伤了脚。

subject: 英语
title: Last weekend

pattern: How was your weekend? / It was ...
rule: 用 How was your weekend? 问对方周末过得怎么样，回答用 It was + 形容词。
subject: 英语
title: Last weekend

pattern: What did you do (last weekend / yesterday / ...)?
rule: 用 What did you do? 问过去做了什么，回答用 I + 动词过去式。

examples.en: What did you do last weekend?
I cleaned my room and washed my clothes.
examples.zh: 我打扫了房间，洗了衣服。

examples.en: I stayed at home and watched TV.

subject: 英语
title: Last weekend

pattern: Did you ...? Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
rule: 用 Did 开头问过去的事情，回答用 Yes, I did. 或 No, I didn't.。

examples.en: Did you play football with Zhang Peng?
Did you like it? Yes, I did.
examples.zh: 你喜欢它吗？是的，我喜欢。

subject: 英语
title: Last weekend

point: 时间状语：last weekend / yesterday / last night
pattern: ... last weekend / yesterday / last night / last Monday / the day before yesterday
rule: 这些词表示过去的时间，常和一般过去时一起用。

examples.en: I cleaned my room and washed my clothes on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我星期六打扫了房间，洗了衣服。

examples.en: I had a cold. I stayed at home all weekend and slept.
examples.zh: 我感冒了。整个周末我待在家里睡觉。

subject: 英语
title: Last weekend

rule: 表示过去发生的事情，动词要变成过去式，很多动词加 -ed。

examples.en: I went to a forest park.

subject: 英语
title: Where did you go?

point: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
pattern: 主语 + 不规则动词过去式 + ...
rule: 有些动词的过去式要特殊记，比如 go→went, see→saw, eat→ate, hurt→hurt。

examples.en: I saw lots of grapes and ate lots of mutton kebabs.
examples.zh: 我看到了很多葡萄，吃了很多羊肉串。

examples.en: I fell off my bike last Saturday and hurt my foot.
examples.zh: 上周六我从自行车上摔下来，弄伤了脚。

examples.en: We saw lots of grapes there.
examples.zh: 我们在那里看到了很多葡萄。

examples.en: I went swimming every weekend and took lots of pictures.
examples.zh: 我每个周末都去游泳，还拍了很多照片。

subject: 英语
title: Where did you go?

pattern: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
rule: 问过去的事情用 Did 开头，后面的动词用原形。
subject: 英语
title: Where did you go?

point: 一般过去时肯定回答（Yes, I/we did.）
pattern: Yes, 主语 + did. / No, 主语 + didn't.
rule: 回答 Did 开头的问题，用 Yes, ... did. 或 No, ... didn't.。
subject: 英语
title: Where did you go?

point: 询问过去地点（Where did you go?）
pattern: Where did you go (over your holiday / last Saturday)?
rule: 问别人过去去了哪里，用 Where did you go? 后面可以加时间。

examples.en: Where did you go over your holiday?
Where did you go last Saturday?
Where did you go over the winter holiday?

subject: 英语
title: Where did you go?

point: 询问过去交通方式（How did you go there?）
pattern: How did you go there? / By + 交通工具
rule: 问过去怎么去的地方，用 How did you go there? 回答用 By + 交通工具。
subject: 英语
title: Where did you go?

point: There was / There were 句型
rule: 用 There was 表示过去有单数或不可数名词，用 There were 表示过去有复数名词。

examples.en: There was only one small building on a hill.
There were no computers or Internet in my time.
examples.zh: 我那时候没有电脑，也没有互联网。

examples.en: There were many trees, and there were many clean rivers.
examples.zh: 那时有很多树，还有很多干净的河流。

subject: 英语
title: Then and now

point: 一般过去时否定句 didn't + 动词原形
rule: 用 didn't 加动词原形，表示过去没有做某事或没有某物。

examples.en: We didn't have a library, and there weren't any computer rooms at all.
examples.zh: 我们没有图书馆，也完全没有电脑室。
那时人们不能用互联网。

subject: 英语
title: Then and now

point: 一般过去时 be 动词 was / were
rule: 单数用 was，复数用 were，表示过去的状态。

examples.en: Before, I was quiet. Now, I'm very active in class.
examples.zh: 以前我很安静。现在我在课堂上很活跃。

examples.en: I was short, so I couldn't ride my bike well.
examples.zh: 我以前很矮，所以骑不好自行车。

subject: 英语
title: Then and now

point: 情态动词 could / couldn't 表过去能力
rule: 用 could 表示过去能做某事，用 couldn't 表示过去不能做某事。

examples.en: Could you see stars at night?
Grandpa could use computers when he was at school.
I couldn't ride my bike well.

subject: 英语
title: Then and now

point: 一般将来时 will + 动词原形
rule: 用 will 加动词原形，表示将来会发生的事。

examples.en: In 2050, there will be house robots.
They will cook, clean and wash the dishes.
examples.zh: 它们会做饭、打扫和洗碗。

examples.en: If we change now, whales and humans will have a bright future.
examples.zh: 如果我们现在改变，鲸鱼和人类都会有光明的未来。

examples.en: We should help the earth now, so birds will have homes and the forests will be healthy and green again.
examples.zh: 我们现在应该帮助地球，这样鸟儿就会有家园，森林也会重新变得健康又绿。

subject: 英语
title: Then and now

point: 情态动词 should 表建议
rule: 用 should 加动词原形，表示应该做某事。

examples.en: We should help the earth now, so birds will have homes and the forests will be healthy and green again.
examples.zh: 我们现在应该帮助地球，这样鸟儿就会有家园，森林也会重新变得健康又绿。

subject: 英语
title: Then and now

rule: 用 is/are 加动词的 -ing 形式，表示正在发生的动作。

examples.en: These people are having fun on the farm.
examples.zh: 这些人在农场玩得很开心。

subject: 英语
title: Mike's happy days

rule: 用动词的过去式表示过去发生的事情。

examples.en: Saturday was a busy day for me.
examples.zh: 星期六对我来说是忙碌的一天。

examples.en: In the morning, I got up early.
What did Mike do on the farm?

subject: 英语
title: Mike's happy days

rule: 用 will 加动词原形表示将来要做的事。

examples.en: Bill will wear a red hat to work.
examples.zh: 比尔上班时会戴一顶红帽子。

examples.en: We will draw pictures and sing songs.
We will also give many prizes to our good students.
examples.zh: 我们还会给优秀学生们发很多奖品。

subject: 英语
title: Mike's happy days

rule: 用 am/is/are going to 加动词原形表示计划或打算做某事。

examples.en: We are going to have a farewell party.
examples.zh: 我们要举办一场告别派对。

examples.en: We are going to give prizes for the best pictures.
examples.zh: 我们会为最好的画颁发奖品。

subject: 英语
title: Mike's happy days

pattern: A is bigger/smaller than B; A is the biggest/smallest
rule: 用比较级加 than 表示两者比较，用 the 加最高级表示三者及以上比较。

examples.en: Is this bigger or smaller than the elephant?
I think it’s bigger than the elephant.
So the whale is the biggest, and the tiger is the smallest.
examples.zh: 所以鲸鱼是最大的，老虎是最小的。

subject: 英语
title: Mike's happy days

rule: 用 There is/are 表示某处有某物。
subject: 英语
title: Mike's happy days

rule: 用 is 加形容词的比较级，再用 than 和另一个对象作比较。

examples.en: My small cat is smaller than yours.
My big dog is bigger than yours.
Now I am taller, taller than before.
Once I was a young boy, younger than I am today.
examples.zh: 我曾经是个小男孩，比今天的我更年轻。

subject: 英语
title: Songs in each unit

point: 一般过去时（行为动词过去式）
rule: 表示过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式。

examples.en: Last weekend I went to the zoo.
I saw a film and played ping-pong.
examples.zh: 我看了一场电影，还打了乒乓球。

examples.en: I bought a gift for you.

subject: 英语
title: Songs in each unit

point: 一般过去时疑问句（What did you do?）
pattern: What did you do + 时间?
rule: 用 What did you do 来问别人过去做了什么，后面加时间。

examples.en: What did you do last weekend?
What did you do last night?

subject: 英语
title: Songs in each unit

point: 一般过去时一般疑问句（Did you ...?）
rule: 用 Did you 开头问过去有没有做某事，后面动词用原形。
subject: 英语
title: Songs in each unit

pattern: 主语 + didn't + 动词原形 + ...
rule: 用 didn't 表示过去没有做某事，后面动词用原形。

examples.en: I didn't see a big round stone.
examples.zh: 我没有看到一块又大又圆的石头。

examples.en: Once I didn't talk a lot.

subject: 英语
title: Songs in each unit

point: 一般现在时（描述现在状态）
pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 形容词/比较级
rule: 用 am/is/are 加形容词来说明现在的样子或状态。

examples.en: Now I am taller, taller than before.
Now I am a big boy, and I'm bigger every day.
examples.zh: 现在我是个大小伙子了，而且每天都更大。

subject: 英语
title: Songs in each unit

pattern: That's the + 最高级形容词 + 名词 + in ...
rule: 用 the 加最高级形容词，表示在某个范围内最……

examples.en: That's the tallest dinosaur in this hall.
examples.zh: 那是这个厅里最高的恐龙。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: It's + 比较级形容词 + than ...
rule: 用比较级形容词加 than，表示比……更……

examples.en: It's taller than both of us together.
Your feet are bigger than mine.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: How tall are you? I'm ... metres.
rule: 用 How tall 询问身高，回答用 I'm 加数字和 metres
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What size are your shoes? My shoes are size ...
rule: 用 What size 询问鞋码，回答用 size 加数字

examples.en: What size are your shoes, Mike?

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: How heavy are you? I'm ... kilograms.
rule: 用 How heavy 询问体重，回答用 I'm 加数字和 kilograms
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 表示过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式

examples.en: I stayed at home with your grandma.
We drank tea in the afternoon and watched TV.
examples.zh: 我们喝了下午茶，还看了电视。

examples.en: I cleaned my room and washed my clothes.
examples.zh: 我打扫了房间，还洗了衣服。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 一般过去时（did 疑问句与回答）
pattern: Did you ...? Yes, we did. / No, we didn't.
rule: 用 Did 开头问过去做过的事，回答用 Yes, ... did. 或 No, ... didn't.
subject: 英语
title: Proverbs

point: 一般过去时（where 疑问句）
rule: 用 Where did you go? 问过去去了哪里。
subject: 英语
title: Proverbs

point: 一般过去时（how 疑问句与交通方式）
pattern: How did you go there? We went there by ...
rule: 用 How did you go there? 问过去怎么去的，回答用 went ... by + 交通工具。
subject: 英语
title: Proverbs

rule: 用 There was/were no ... 表示过去没有某物。

examples.en: There was no library in my old school.
examples.zh: 我以前的学校里没有图书馆。

examples.en: There were no computers or Internet in my time.
examples.zh: 我那时候没有电脑也没有网络。

subject: 英语
title: Proverbs

point: 一般过去时（was/were 描述过去状态）
rule: 用 I was ... 描述过去是什么样。

examples.en: I was short, so I couldn't ride my bike well.
examples.zh: 我以前个子小，自行车骑得不好。

subject: 英语
title: Proverbs

point: 情态动词 couldn't（过去不能）
rule: 用 couldn't 表示过去不能做某事。

examples.en: I was short, so I couldn't ride my bike well.
examples.zh: 我以前个子小，自行车骑得不好。

subject: 英语
title: Proverbs

pattern: Where are you going? / I'm going to ...
rule: 用 Where are you going? 问别人要去哪里，回答用 I'm going to + 地点。

examples.en: Little Red-Cap: I'm going to my grandmother's house.
examples.zh: 小红帽：我要去我奶奶家。

subject: 英语
title: Short plays

pattern: What for? / I am going to ... with it/them.
rule: 用 What for? 问用途，回答用 I am going to + 动词 + with it/them 表示打算用某物做某事。

examples.zh: 稻草卖家：当然。用来做什么？

examples.en: Pete: I am going to build a house with it.
examples.zh: 皮特：我打算用它盖一座房子。

examples.en: Pat: I am going to build a house with them.
examples.zh: 帕特：我打算用它们盖一座房子。

examples.en: Paul: I am going to build a house with them.
examples.zh: 保罗：我打算用它们盖一座房子。

subject: 英语
title: Short plays

point: 一般过去时（叙述过去发生的事）
pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式（如 left, met, built, came, went, saw, ate, killed）
rule: 讲过去发生的事情时，动词要用过去式，比如 left, met, built, came, went, saw, ate, killed。

examples.en: One day, they left their mother's house.
examples.zh: 有一天，他们离开了妈妈的家。

examples.en: One day, Pete met a man.
examples.zh: 有一天，皮特遇到了一个人。

examples.en: So Pete built his house of straw.
examples.zh: 于是皮特用稻草盖了他的房子。

examples.en: The wolf blew the straw house down.

subject: 英语
title: Short plays

point: 一般现在时（描述习惯或事实）
pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数形式（如 is, are, live, help, sing）
rule: 说现在的事实或习惯时，动词用原形；主语是 he/she/it 时动词加 s 或 es。

examples.en: They help me see you better.
examples.zh: 它们帮我更好地看见你。

examples.en: They help me hear you better.
examples.zh: 它们帮我更好地听见你。

subject: 英语
title: Short plays

pattern: A is + 形容词比较级 + than B
rule: 比较两样东西时，用 形容词比较级 + than，比如 heavier than, stronger than。

examples.en: Bricks are heavier than straw and sticks.
Brick houses are stronger than straw houses and stick houses.
examples.zh: 砖房比稻草房和树枝房坚固。

subject: 英语
title: Short plays

point: 情态动词 can 表请求
rule: 用 Can I please ...? 礼貌地请求做某事，用 Can you ...? 请求别人做某事。

examples.en: Pete: Can I please buy your straw?
examples.zh: 皮特：我可以买你的稻草吗？

examples.en: Pat: Can I please buy your sticks?
examples.zh: 帕特：我可以买你的树枝吗？

examples.en: Paul: Can I please buy your bricks?
examples.zh: 保罗：我可以买你的砖吗？

examples.en: Wolf: Can you hear the sweet little birds?
examples.zh: 狼：你能听到那些甜美的小鸟吗？

subject: 英语
title: Short plays

rule: 用 Don't + 动词原形 表示不要做某事，用来提醒或禁止。

examples.en: Mother: Don't run off the path.
Mother: Don't go into the woods.
Mother: Don't forget to say "Good morning!" to your grandmother.
examples.zh: 妈妈：别忘了跟奶奶说“早上好！”

subject: 英语
title: Short plays

pattern: 动词原形 → 过去式（如 go → went, have → had）
rule: 有些动词变过去式时不按规则加 -ed，要单独记住它们的过去式形式。
subject: 英语
title: Irregular verbs

pattern: Do you ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
rule: 用 Do you 开头问别人做不做某事，回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

pattern: Can I ...? Sure. / Yes, you can.
rule: 用 Can I 开头请求别人允许自己做某事，回答可以用 Sure.

examples.en: Can I use your ruler, please?
examples.zh: 我能用一下你的尺子吗？

subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

point: 特殊疑问句 What's your name?
rule: 用 What's your name? 问别人的名字，回答用 My name's ...
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

rule: 用 Where is 问某物在哪里，回答用 It's ... 说明位置。
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

pattern: How many ... do you have? I have ...
rule: 用 How many 问数量，回答用 I have ... 说有多少。

examples.en: How many books do you have?

subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

point: 特殊疑问句 What colour do you like?
pattern: What colour do you like? I like ...
rule: 用 What colour do you like? 问别人喜欢什么颜色，回答用 I like ...
subject: 英语
title: Pronunciation

rule: 用 What's your ...'s job? 问别人的工作，用 She's a ... 回答职业。
subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 情态动词 can 表能力或建议
pattern: What can we do for ...? / We can ...
rule: 用 can 表示“能、可以”，后面加动词原形。

examples.en: What can we do for them?
examples.zh: 我们能为他们做些什么？
我们可以做一些家务活。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

point: 询问姓名与描述外貌性格
pattern: What's your friend's name? / His name is ... / He's ... and ...
rule: 用 What's your friend's name? 问朋友的名字，用 His name is ... 回答，再用形容词描述外貌和性格。

examples.en: He's also kind. He often helps me.
examples.zh: 他也很友善。他经常帮助我。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 There is 表示“有一个……”，用 There are 表示“有一些……”。

examples.zh: 这里有一个太极拳俱乐部。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

rule: 用 is/are 加动词的 -ing 形式表示正在发生的动作。

examples.en: Chen Jie is making the bed.
In the kindergarten, John and Class One are singing songs together.
examples.zh: 在幼儿园，约翰和一班（的孩子们）在一起唱歌。

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions

pattern: What's the weather like in ...? / It's ...
rule: 用 What's the weather like in ...? 问某地天气，用 It's ... 回答天气状况。

examples.en: What's the weather like in Sydney?
It's only two degrees in Beijing.

subject: 英语
title: Useful expressions
